generic.Defined scope/population: All SIU referrals raised from this claim that are awaiting an acceptance acknowledgement from SIU intake.
generic.In-scope period: From referral submission date until SIU acceptance is confirmed, chased at 2 business days.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: SIU case number, assigned investigator name and acceptance status populated on the ClaimCenter SIU panel.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of referrals submitted on the claim equals count of SIU acknowledgements recorded in claim notes.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: SIU acknowledgement email or queue receipt filed in claim notes with the date and time received.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Referrals unacknowledged after 2 business days logged with a chase activity and its outcome.
generic.Test population: Every SIU referral raised on the claim during the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if referral status is still Submitted after 2 business days or the SIU case number is blank.
generic.Exception handling path: Raise a chase activity to the SIU intake queue and escalate to the assigned SIU Investigator.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Referral shows Accepted with SIU case number and investigator name written back to the claim.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter SIU activity panel and the claim notes holding the SIU acknowledgement receipt.

steps.title: Open the claim SIU activity panel in ClaimCenter
sop: Search the claim number in ClaimCenter and open the claim summary view.
Select the SIU activity panel showing referral records for this claim.
Identify the referral record matching the submission you raised.
Done when the correct referral record is open in the SIU activity panel.
verify: Referral record shown belongs to the claim number under review.
Pass when exactly one open referral record is identified for the claim.

steps.title: Check the referral status reads Accepted in ClaimCenter
sop: Read the referral status field on the SIU activity panel.
Distinguish Accepted from Submitted, Returned or Awaiting triage.
Record the observed status and the status date in the claim diary note.
Done when the current referral status and its date are recorded on the claim.
verify: Status recorded on the claim matches the status shown in ClaimCenter.
Pass when the referral status reads Accepted with an acceptance timestamp.

steps.title: Verify SIU case number and investigator write-back in FRISS
sop: Open the matching SIU case in FRISS Fraud Detection.
Confirm the FRISS case number and assigned investigator name match the claim write-back.
Correct the write-back in ClaimCenter where the values differ or are blank.
Done when case number and investigator name agree across FRISS and ClaimCenter.
verify: SIU case number on the claim equals the FRISS case number character for character.
Pass when investigator name is populated and matches the FRISS assignment.

steps.title: File the SIU acknowledgement receipt into ClaimCenter claim notes
sop: Copy the SIU acknowledgement email text or the intake queue receipt.
Paste it into a ClaimCenter claim note typed as SIU Acknowledgement.
State the date and time received and the SIU case number in the note.
Done when the acknowledgement note is saved on the claim with date and time.
verify: Claim note contains the acknowledgement text and the SIU case number.
Pass when the note carries a received date and time matching the receipt.

steps.title: Raise a chase activity to the SIU intake queue in ClaimCenter
sop: Calculate elapsed business days from submission to today.
Where 2 business days have passed with no acknowledgement, create a chase activity.
Address the activity to the SIU intake queue and reference the referral id.
Done when a chase activity exists or the 2-day threshold is confirmed not breached.
verify: Chase activity, where required, names the SIU intake queue as assignee.
Pass when no unacknowledged referral is older than 2 business days without a chase.

steps.title: Confirm acceptance with the assigned investigator in FRISS
sop: Review the FRISS case to confirm it has been accepted rather than parked at intake.
Reply to the referring examiner through the FRISS case note, not by email alone.
Note any information the examiner must still supply for the case to proceed.
Done when the investigator has confirmed acceptance in a FRISS case note.
verify: FRISS case note confirming acceptance is dated and attributed to the investigator.
Pass when both FRISS and ClaimCenter show the referral as accepted.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every fraud red-flag indicator observed on this claim that must be ticked before the claim advances.
generic.In-scope period: From first observation of a red flag until the claim moves to Under SIU review.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each ticked indicator carries a factual basis note and the claim-level fraud flag is set.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Indicator count ticked in ClaimCenter equals indicator count carried on the FRISS case.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Red-flag panel entries retained with the ticking user and timestamp on the claim record.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Indicators considered then rejected recorded with the reason they were not ticked.
generic.Test population: All claims flagged for SIU screening in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any payment transaction is dated after the fraud flag was set on the claim.
generic.Exception handling path: Where the flag fails to propagate to FRISS, log an incident and re-run the propagation.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Claim carries at least one active indicator with a factual basis and status Under SIU review.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter red-flag panel and the linked FRISS Fraud Detection case record.

steps.title: Open the claim red-flag panel in ClaimCenter
sop: Open the claim in ClaimCenter and select the fraud red-flag panel.
Review the full indicator list for the line of business before ticking anything.
Confirm no prior screening already ticked these indicators on the claim.
Done when the red-flag panel is open and prior entries have been reviewed.
verify: Panel shown is the indicator set for this claim line of business.
Pass when existing indicator entries have been read before new ticks are made.

steps.title: Tick each observed indicator on the ClaimCenter red-flag panel
sop: Tick late reporting, coverage inception proximity, prior-loss history and unwitnessed loss where observed.
Tick only indicators actually evidenced in the claim file.
Leave no indicator ambiguous - each is either ticked or explicitly left clear.
Done when every observed indicator is ticked on the panel.
verify: Every ticked indicator maps to a document or statement in the claim file.
Pass when at least one indicator is ticked and none is ticked without support.

steps.title: Record a factual basis note under each ticked indicator in ClaimCenter
sop: Write one line of observed fact under each ticked indicator.
State dates, amounts and sources rather than conclusions about the claimant.
Avoid any wording asserting that fraud has occurred.
Done when each ticked indicator carries a one-line factual basis note.
verify: No basis note contains a conclusion of fraud or an opinion about intent.
Pass when the count of basis notes equals the count of ticked indicators.

steps.title: Set the claim-level fraud flag to block payment in ClaimCenter
sop: Set the claim-level fraud flag on the claim header.
Confirm the payment screen now blocks indemnity issue pending SIU screening.
Record the flag set date and the setting user in the claim diary.
Done when the fraud flag is active and payment is blocked on the claim.
verify: Attempting a payment on the claim returns the SIU block message.
Pass when the fraud flag shows active with a set date and user.

steps.title: Confirm flag propagation to the FRISS case
sop: Open the linked case in FRISS Fraud Detection.
Check that each indicator ticked in ClaimCenter appears on the FRISS case.
Report any indicator that failed to propagate to the claims examiner.
Done when the FRISS case carries the same indicator set as the claim.
verify: Indicator list in FRISS matches the ClaimCenter red-flag panel item for item.
Pass when no ticked indicator is missing from the FRISS case.

steps.title: Move the claim status to Under SIU review in ClaimCenter
sop: Change the claim status to Under SIU review once flags and notes are complete.
Confirm downstream workflow activities reflect the new status.
Check no payment transaction is dated after the flag was set.
Done when the claim status reads Under SIU review with no post-flag payments.
verify: Claim financial history shows no payment dated after the fraud flag timestamp.
Pass when claim status is Under SIU review and the flag remains active.

generic.Defined scope/population: The SIU referral date field and referral package record for this claim in ClaimCenter.
generic.In-scope period: From red-flag identification date through to referral submission, capped at 48 hours.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: SIU referral date on the claim header is non-null and equals the actual submission date.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: One referral date entry exists for each referral package filed in the document repository.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Referral package PDF filed under document type SIU Referral with its upload timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Referrals logged beyond 48 hours recorded with the delay reason and supervisor sign-off.
generic.Test population: All claims referred to SIU in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the SIU referral date is null or later than 48 hours after red-flag identification.
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate a late or missing referral date to the claims supervisor for correction and rationale.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Referral date populated, package attached and a diary note naming referrer and indicators.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter claim header and the SIU Referral folder in the claim document repository.

steps.title: Establish the red-flag identification date in ClaimCenter
sop: Open the red-flag panel and read the timestamp of the first ticked indicator.
Record that timestamp as the red-flag identification date.
Note it in the claim diary so the 48-hour clock is auditable.
Done when the red-flag identification date is recorded on the claim.
verify: Recorded date matches the earliest indicator timestamp on the panel.
Pass when the identification date is present and unambiguous.

steps.title: Populate the SIU referral date field on the ClaimCenter claim header
sop: Enter the actual referral submission date into the SIU referral date field.
Do not enter a planned or backdated value.
Save the claim header and confirm the field persists.
Done when the SIU referral date field is populated and saved.
verify: Field value equals the submission timestamp on the referral record.
Pass when the SIU referral date is non-null on the claim header.

steps.title: Check the referral date falls within 48 hours of identification
sop: Compare the referral date against the recorded red-flag identification date.
Calculate elapsed hours and record the result in the claim diary.
Where the gap exceeds 48 hours, record the reason for the delay.
Done when the elapsed time is calculated and recorded with any delay reason.
verify: Elapsed calculation is shown against both dates in the diary note.
Pass when elapsed time is within 48 hours or a delay reason is recorded.

steps.title: Attach the referral package PDF to the claim document repository
sop: Upload the referral package PDF to the claim document folder.
Set the document type to SIU Referral so it is retrievable at audit.
Confirm the upload timestamp and version are recorded on the document.
Done when the package is filed under document type SIU Referral.
verify: Document appears in the repository with type SIU Referral and a timestamp.
Pass when the attached package matches the version that was submitted.

steps.title: Add the referral diary note in ClaimCenter
sop: Write a diary note naming who referred the claim and on which indicators.
State the referral date and the SIU intake queue used.
Reference the attached referral package document id.
Done when the diary note names referrer, indicators and referral date.
verify: Diary note names the referring user and lists the indicators relied on.
Pass when the note references the filed referral package document.

steps.title: Confirm the logged date with the SIU investigator in ClaimCenter
sop: Review the claim header referral date against the SIU intake receipt date.
Raise any mismatch back to the claims examiner for correction.
Note the confirmation on the claim so both sides agree the referral date.
Done when the investigator has confirmed or challenged the logged date.
verify: Referral date on the claim equals the SIU intake receipt date.
Pass when no unresolved date mismatch remains on the claim.

generic.Defined scope/population: The drafted SIU referral for this claim requiring an explicit supervisor approve or decline decision.
generic.In-scope period: From routing of the referral approval activity until the decision is recorded.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Approval record holds approver name, decision, rationale and decision timestamp.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Each routed approval activity has exactly one recorded decision on the referral.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Approval note retained on the referral record with the approver user id and timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Declined referrals logged with the decline reason and the red-flag panel closed out.
generic.Test population: All SIU referrals routed for supervisor approval in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the approver user id equals the referral author user id or rationale is blank.
generic.Exception handling path: Re-route to an alternative supervisor where segregation of duties is breached.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Referral carries a supervisor approve or decline decision with rationale and timestamp.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter SIU referral approval activity and the claim document repository.

steps.title: Route the drafted referral for approval in ClaimCenter
sop: Open the drafted referral and select the SIU referral approval activity.
Assign it to the claims supervisor with authority for this line of business.
Attach the drafted referral package so the approver can read the basis.
Done when the approval activity is assigned and carries the draft package.
verify: Approval activity shows an assignee with supervisor authority.
Pass when the routed activity has the draft referral package attached.

steps.title: Review the referral basis in ClaimCenter
sop: Read the red-flag rationale and confirm each indicator is evidenced in the file.
Check the referral names the loss facts, policy history and indicators relied on.
Note any gap that must be closed before the referral is submitted.
Done when the referral basis has been reviewed and gaps are noted.
verify: Review note addresses each indicator cited in the referral.
Pass when no cited indicator is left without an evidence reference.

steps.title: Record the approve or decline decision with rationale in ClaimCenter
sop: Select approve or decline on the referral approval activity.
Write the rationale for the decision in the approval note.
Save so the decision timestamp and approver id are stamped on the record.
Done when an explicit decision with rationale is saved on the referral.
verify: Approval record shows a decision value and a non-blank rationale.
Pass when the decision timestamp and approver name are both recorded.

steps.title: Check segregation of duties on the approval in ClaimCenter
sop: Compare the approver user id against the referral author user id.
Where they match, void the approval and route to a different supervisor.
Record the segregation check outcome on the referral.
Done when the approver is confirmed different from the referral author.
verify: Approver user id does not equal the referral author user id.
Pass when the segregation check outcome is recorded on the referral.

steps.title: Close out the red-flag panel on a declined referral in ClaimCenter
sop: Where declined, record the decline reason against the claim.
Close out the red-flag panel entries with a documented basis for each.
Release the claim-level fraud flag only after the close-out is recorded.
Done when a declined referral has a recorded reason and a closed-out panel.
verify: Each closed-out indicator carries a documented basis for closure.
Pass when no fraud flag is released without a recorded decline reason.

steps.title: File the approval decision to the claim document repository
sop: Export the approval record and file it in the claim document folder.
Type the document so audit can retrieve the approval independently.
Reference the document id in the claim diary note.
Done when the approval decision is filed and referenced on the claim.
verify: Filed approval document carries the approver name and decision date.
Pass when the claim diary references the filed approval document id.

generic.Defined scope/population: All loss, policy and red-flag documents required by the SIU referral package completeness checklist.
generic.In-scope period: Full policy transaction history to date of loss plus the claim file to the referral date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Package holds loss facts, policy history, prior-loss report, FRISS score sheet and rationale.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Attachment count on the package equals the item count on the completeness checklist.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Assembled package version stored in the claim document repository with an assembly date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Checklist items marked missing recorded with the reason and the resolution taken.
generic.Test population: Every SIU referral package assembled during the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any mandatory checklist section is absent from the assembled package.
generic.Exception handling path: Where a document cannot be obtained, record the reason and note it in the package cover.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Package contains policy history, loss facts and red-flag rationale sections in full.
generic.Evidence location: Claim document repository referral folder and the linked FRISS case attachments.

steps.title: Assemble loss facts documents from ClaimCenter
sop: Export the FNOL and the loss description from ClaimCenter.
Add the recorded statement transcript where a statement was taken.
Place these in the loss facts section of the referral package.
Done when the loss facts section holds FNOL, loss description and any transcript.
verify: Loss facts section lists each document with its ClaimCenter document id.
Pass when the FNOL and loss description are both present.

steps.title: Attach policy declarations and transaction history from ClaimCenter
sop: Pull the policy declarations page effective at the date of loss.
Export the full policy transaction history covering inception, endorsements and lapses.
Add both to the policy history section of the package.
Done when declarations and full transaction history are in the package.
verify: Transaction history spans policy inception through the loss date without gaps.
Pass when declarations match the coverage in force on the loss date.

steps.title: Add the prior-loss report and FRISS score sheet
sop: Run the prior claims history report for the claimant and the risk.
Export the current FRISS score sheet with its contributing factors.
Attach both to the package with their run dates shown.
Done when prior-loss report and FRISS score sheet are attached with run dates.
verify: Both reports show a run date on or after the red-flag identification date.
Pass when the FRISS score sheet lists the top contributing factors.

steps.title: Write the red-flag rationale section referencing exhibits
sop: List each ticked indicator in the rationale section.
Cite the supporting document reference beside each indicator.
Keep the wording factual with no assertion that fraud occurred.
Done when every indicator in the rationale carries a document reference.
verify: Each rationale line names an attached document reference.
Pass when no indicator appears in the rationale without a supporting reference.

steps.title: Run the package completeness checklist in the document repository
sop: Work the referral package completeness checklist item by item.
Mark each item present or missing with the document reference.
Resolve every missing item or record why it cannot be obtained.
Done when the completeness checklist shows no unresolved missing item.
verify: Attachment count equals the checklist item count for present items.
Pass when every missing item carries a recorded reason and resolution.

steps.title: Review the assembled package with the SIU investigator in FRISS
sop: Read the assembled package against the SIU intake expectations.
Flag any section that would cause the referral to be returned at triage.
Record the review outcome as a FRISS case note.
Done when the investigator has recorded a package review outcome.
verify: Review note names each section reviewed and its adequacy.
Pass when no section is marked inadequate at the point of submission.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every ticked red flag on the claim assessed against the SIU referral criteria matrix for the line of business.
generic.In-scope period: The current criteria matrix version effective at the date of assessment.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Assessment note holds criteria matrix version, loss state and mandatory or discretionary conclusion.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of indicators assessed equals count of indicators ticked on the red-flag panel.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Criteria assessment note stored on the claim with the matrix version and assessment date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: No-referral conclusions logged with the specific criteria not met so the decision is auditable.
generic.Test population: All screened claims with at least one active indicator in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the assessment omits the mandatory-reporting threshold check for the loss state.
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate conflicting state thresholds to the Compliance Analyst for a written direction.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Assessment names the criteria version and states mandatory, discretionary or no-referral.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter assessment note plus the criteria matrix entry held in the GRC platform.

steps.title: Retrieve the current SIU referral criteria matrix from the GRC platform
sop: Open the SIU referral criteria matrix for the claim line of business in Archer GRC.
Confirm the matrix version is the one currently effective.
Share the version reference with the claims examiner for the assessment note.
Done when the effective criteria matrix version is identified and shared.
verify: Matrix retrieved shows an effective-from date on or before the assessment date.
Pass when the version reference is recorded for use in the assessment.

steps.title: Compare each ticked red flag against the criteria matrix
sop: List the ticked indicators from the ClaimCenter red-flag panel.
Map each indicator to its criteria row and note whether the criterion is met.
Record indicators that meet no criterion so the gap is visible.
Done when every ticked indicator is mapped to a criteria outcome.
verify: Mapping covers every indicator ticked on the red-flag panel.
Pass when no ticked indicator is left unmapped in the assessment.

steps.title: Check the loss state mandatory-reporting threshold table
sop: Look up the loss state in the mandatory-reporting threshold table in Archer GRC.
Note whether the state requires reporting on suspicion regardless of claim value.
Record the statute reference supporting the threshold applied.
Done when the loss state threshold and its statute reference are recorded.
verify: Threshold recorded names the loss state and the governing statute.
Pass when a threshold outcome exists for every state with a reporting nexus.

steps.title: Read the FRISS score and contributing factors into the assessment
sop: Open the FRISS case and read the model score and top contributing factors.
Note which contributing factors align with the criteria matrix rows.
Add the score and factors to the assessment note as supporting context.
Done when the FRISS score and factors are captured in the assessment.
verify: Assessment note holds the FRISS score value and its capture date.
Pass when the listed factors match those shown on the FRISS case.

steps.title: Record the mandatory, discretionary or no-referral conclusion in ClaimCenter
sop: State one conclusion of mandatory referral, discretionary referral or no-referral.
Name the criteria matrix version relied on in the note.
Where no-referral, list the specific criteria that were not met.
Done when the conclusion and its basis are saved on the claim.
verify: Conclusion is one of the three controlled values and names the matrix version.
Pass when a no-referral conclusion lists the unmet criteria explicitly.

steps.title: Log the assessment outcome in the GRC platform register
sop: Create or update the register entry for this claim assessment in Archer GRC.
Record the conclusion, matrix version, loss state and assessment date.
Link the entry to the claim number and FRISS case where one exists.
Done when the register holds a linked entry for this assessment.
verify: Register entry references the claim number and the assessment conclusion.
Pass when no assessed claim is missing a register entry.

generic.Defined scope/population: Claimant, insured, vehicle or property address, phone, bank account, providers, repairers and public adjusters on this claim.
generic.In-scope period: Claims and identifier data across the portfolio window supported by the warehouse extract.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each searched entity carries an identifier value and a recorded permissible purpose code.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Entities submitted to the link tool equal entities listed on the scope note.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Network graph and hit list exported as PDF and attached with the analysis run timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Links reviewed and rejected as innocent recorded with the explanation accepted.
generic.Test population: All link analyses run against SIU-screened claims in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any consumer-report style search is recorded without a permissible purpose code.
generic.Exception handling path: Where an identifier returns no data, record the gap and note the alternative source tried.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Link analysis PDF attached to the case with run timestamp and permissible purpose recorded.
generic.Evidence location: FRISS case attachments plus the LexisNexis Risk search log for this case number.

steps.title: Build the entity scope list for link analysis in FRISS
sop: List claimant, insured, vehicle VIN or property address, phone and bank account.
Add treating providers, repair shops and public adjusters named on the claim.
Record why each entity is in scope so searches stay defensible.
Done when the scope list is recorded on the FRISS case with reasons.
verify: Every entity on the list has a stated reason for inclusion.
Pass when the scope list covers all identifier types available on the claim.

steps.title: Record the permissible purpose code before searching LexisNexis Risk
sop: Determine the permissible purpose applicable to an insurance fraud investigation.
Enter the purpose code on each LexisNexis Risk search request.
Capture the purpose code in the FRISS case note for the analysis run.
Done when the permissible purpose code is entered and recorded.
verify: Search log shows a purpose code against each consumer-report style search.
Pass when no search was executed with a blank permissible purpose.

steps.title: Run the link analysis across the entity set in FRISS
sop: Submit the scoped entity set to the FRISS link analysis function.
Include identifier types for address, phone, bank account and VIN.
Record the run timestamp and the entity count submitted.
Done when the link analysis has run over the full scoped entity set.
verify: Entity count submitted equals the count on the scope list.
Pass when the run completes with a recorded timestamp.

steps.title: Extend the search to portfolio claims in the data warehouse
sop: Query the enterprise data warehouse for other claims sharing the returned identifiers.
Restrict the query to the agreed portfolio window and record the window used.
Return the matched claim numbers and their status to the investigator.
Done when the warehouse query has returned a matched claim list.
verify: Query output names the identifier that produced each match.
Pass when the matched claim list is reconciled to the warehouse row count.

steps.title: Review the network graph for shared identifiers across open claims
sop: Read the returned graph for identifiers shared across otherwise unrelated claims.
Mark each candidate link as significant or innocent with a short reason.
Note the exposure attached to the claims in each significant cluster.
Done when every candidate link carries a significance decision.
verify: Each rejected link records the innocent explanation accepted.
Pass when no candidate link is left without a decision.

steps.title: Export and attach the network graph and hit list to the FRISS case
sop: Export the network graph and the hit list as a single PDF.
Attach the PDF to the SIU case file with the analysis run timestamp.
Note the permissible purpose code on the attachment record.
Done when the analysis PDF is attached with timestamp and purpose code.
verify: Attached PDF shows the run timestamp on its first page.
Pass when the case holds exactly one current link analysis export.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every item on the structured red-flag checklist for this claim plus the FRISS predictive model output.
generic.In-scope period: Policy inception to date of loss for coverage timing and the full prior claims history window.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Screening outcome code, FRISS model score and top contributing factors recorded on the claim.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Checklist items answered equals total checklist items for the line of business.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Screening result stored on the claim with the model score version and screening date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Checklist items that cannot be answered logged with the missing information needed.
generic.Test population: All claims screened for fraud indicators in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any checklist item is left blank or the outcome code is missing.
generic.Exception handling path: Where data is unavailable, set outcome to monitor and diary the item for re-screening.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Claim carries a screening result of clear, monitor or refer with the model score captured.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter screening result panel and the FRISS Fraud Detection score record.

steps.title: Work the structured red-flag checklist in ClaimCenter
sop: Open the structured red-flag checklist for the claim line of business.
Answer each item in turn and leave none blank.
Where an item cannot be answered, record the missing information required.
Done when every checklist item carries an answer or a recorded gap.
verify: Answered item count equals the total checklist item count.
Pass when no checklist item remains blank.

steps.title: Read the FRISS predictive model score and contributing factors
sop: Open the FRISS case for the claim and read the model score.
List the top contributing factors shown against the claim.
Copy the score and factors onto the claim screening record.
Done when the model score and contributing factors are on the claim.
verify: Score on the claim matches the score shown in FRISS.
Pass when at least the top contributing factors are captured.

steps.title: Compare loss date against policy inception and endorsements in ClaimCenter
sop: Read the policy inception date and any recent coverage increase or endorsement.
Calculate the interval between inception or endorsement and the loss date.
Record proximity findings against the relevant checklist item.
Done when coverage timing proximity is calculated and recorded.
verify: Recorded interval is calculated from dates held in ClaimCenter.
Pass when the coverage timing checklist item is answered from that calculation.

steps.title: Check prior claims history for claimant and risk in ClaimCenter
sop: Run the prior claims history for the claimant and for the loss location or vehicle.
Note repeat losses, repeat providers and repeat repairers.
Record the findings against the prior-loss checklist items.
Done when prior claims history findings are recorded on the claim.
verify: History searched covers both claimant and the insured risk.
Pass when prior-loss checklist items are answered from the history output.

steps.title: Review borderline indicators with the SIU investigator in FRISS
sop: Review checklist items the examiner marked uncertain.
Advise whether each supports referral, monitoring or clearance.
Record the advice as a FRISS case note for audit.
Done when each uncertain item carries investigator advice.
verify: Advice note addresses every item flagged uncertain by the examiner.
Pass when no uncertain item is carried into the outcome undecided.

steps.title: Record the screening outcome code on the claim in ClaimCenter
sop: Select one outcome of clear, monitor or refer.
Save the outcome with the model score and screening date on the claim.
Where the outcome is refer, trigger the referral preparation activity.
Done when the screening outcome code and score are saved on the claim.
verify: Outcome value is one of clear, monitor or refer with a screening date.
Pass when the claim carries both the outcome code and the model score.

generic.Defined scope/population: Diary activities required on this claim for SIU status check-ins and claim-hold review.
generic.In-scope period: From SIU referral acceptance until the SIU hold is released or the case closes.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each diary carries a due date, a named owner and the SIU investigator as watcher.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Open diary count matches the check-in cadence required by the assigned priority tier.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Diary activities retained on the claim record with creation date and creating user.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Diaries closed without action logged with the reason recorded in the claim note.
generic.Test population: All claims under an active SIU hold in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if no open future-dated SIU status diary exists on a claim under SIU hold.
generic.Exception handling path: Where a diary lapses, recreate it and escalate the lapse to the claims supervisor.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Claim holds an open future-dated SIU status diary with a named owner.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter claim diary and activity list for this claim number.

steps.title: Confirm the SIU priority tier and cadence in ClaimCenter
sop: Read the SIU priority tier written back onto the claim.
Look up the check-in cadence required for that tier.
Record the cadence in the claim diary note so the interval is auditable.
Done when the tier and its required check-in cadence are recorded.
verify: Cadence recorded matches the tier shown on the claim.
Pass when a tier value is present on the claim before diaries are set.

steps.title: Create the recurring SIU status diary on the claim in ClaimCenter
sop: Create a recurring diary activity for SIU status check-ins.
Set the recurrence interval to the tier cadence.
Set the subject so the diary is identifiable on the workload report.
Done when a recurring SIU status diary exists at the tier cadence.
verify: Diary recurrence interval equals the recorded tier cadence.
Pass when the diary has a future-dated next due date.

steps.title: Create the separate claim-hold review diary in ClaimCenter
sop: Create a second diary specifically for the claim-hold review date.
Set the due date before the state claim-handling deadline.
State in the diary text that the hold must be reviewed or released.
Done when a dated claim-hold review diary exists on the claim.
verify: Hold review due date falls before the claim-handling deadline.
Pass when the hold review diary is separate from the status diary.

steps.title: Name the diary owner and add the investigator as watcher
sop: Set the handling adjuster as owner on both diaries.
Add the assigned SIU investigator as watcher on the SIU status diary.
Confirm both parties can see the diary in their ClaimCenter worklist.
Done when owner and watcher are set on both diary activities.
verify: Each diary shows a named owner rather than a queue placeholder.
Pass when the SIU investigator appears as watcher on the status diary.

steps.title: Confirm the diaries are set on the claim and survive reassignment
sop: Check each diary is attached to the claim entity rather than the user record.
Simulate or confirm behaviour on reassignment with the ClaimCenter configuration.
Correct any diary that would be lost when the claim is reassigned.
Done when both diaries are confirmed claim-level activities.
verify: Diary record shows the claim as its parent entity.
Pass when no SIU diary is held only against an individual user.

steps.title: Acknowledge the diary schedule from the SIU side in ClaimCenter
sop: Review the diary dates against the SIU case milestone plan.
Request an interval change where the cadence conflicts with case milestones.
Record acknowledgement of the schedule in the claim note.
Done when the investigator has acknowledged or amended the diary schedule.
verify: Acknowledgement note is dated and names the diary intervals agreed.
Pass when no unresolved conflict remains between diary and case milestones.

generic.Defined scope/population: The approved SIU referral for this claim being submitted to the intake queue for its line of business and loss state.
generic.In-scope period: From red-flag identification to queue submission, target within 48 hours.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Submission record holds queue name, submission timestamp and supervisor approval reference.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Referrals submitted equals referrals appearing in the SIU intake queue for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Queue entry retained with submission timestamp and the submitting user id.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Submissions beyond 48 hours logged with the delay reason and supervisor acknowledgement.
generic.Test population: All referrals submitted to the SIU intake queue in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a queued referral has no supervisor approval record attached.
generic.Exception handling path: Withdraw and resubmit where the referral lands in the wrong queue for the loss state.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Referral present in the correct intake queue with status Awaiting triage and a timestamp.
generic.Evidence location: FRISS SIU intake queue entry and the ClaimCenter referral submission record.

steps.title: Confirm supervisor approval is present in ClaimCenter before submitting
sop: Open the referral record and read the approval activity outcome.
Confirm the decision is approve and the approver is not the referral author.
Abort submission where approval is absent or the decision is decline.
Done when an approve decision by a distinct approver is confirmed.
verify: Approval record shows decision approve with approver name and timestamp.
Pass when no submission proceeds without a recorded approval.

steps.title: Select the correct SIU intake queue for line of business and loss state
sop: Read the line of business and the loss state from the claim header.
Select the matching SIU intake queue in the submission form.
Record the queue name chosen in the claim diary note.
Done when the queue matching line of business and loss state is selected.
verify: Queue selected matches the routing rule for that line and state.
Pass when the chosen queue name is recorded on the claim.

steps.title: Submit the referral from ClaimCenter
sop: Press submit on the approved referral record.
Capture the returned submission timestamp on the claim.
Confirm no validation error blocked the submission.
Done when the referral is submitted and the timestamp is captured.
verify: Submission timestamp is present on the referral record.
Pass when the referral state changes from draft to submitted.

steps.title: Verify the referral appears in the FRISS intake queue
sop: Open the SIU intake queue in FRISS Fraud Detection.
Locate the referral and confirm status reads Awaiting triage.
Confirm the attached approval record travelled with the referral.
Done when the referral is visible in the queue awaiting triage.
verify: Queue entry status reads Awaiting triage with the claim number shown.
Pass when no queued referral lacks a supervisor approval record.

steps.title: Measure elapsed time from red-flag identification to submission
sop: Compare the submission timestamp with the red-flag identification date.
Record elapsed hours in the claim diary note.
Where elapsed time exceeds 48 hours, record the delay reason.
Done when elapsed time is recorded with any delay reason.
verify: Elapsed hours are calculated from dates held in ClaimCenter.
Pass when elapsed time is within 48 hours or a reason is recorded.

steps.title: Acknowledge queue receipt back to the claim in FRISS
sop: Trigger the intake acknowledgement from the FRISS queue entry.
Confirm the acknowledgement writes back to the originating claim.
Note in FRISS any missing element that would return the referral at triage.
Done when the intake acknowledgement is issued and written back.
verify: Claim shows an acknowledgement note sourced from the FRISS queue.
Pass when every queued referral has an acknowledgement or a return reason.

generic.Defined scope/population: The assembled referral package and all its attachments for this claim at the point of submission.
generic.In-scope period: The package version current at the submission date, frozen thereafter.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Submission reference, package version and attachment list recorded on the referral record.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Attachment count on the referral record equals the completeness checklist item count.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Submitted package version filed in the claim document repository so later edits cannot overwrite it.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Attachments that failed to upload logged with the retry outcome recorded.
generic.Test population: All referral packages submitted in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the submitted package is not attached to the referral record.
generic.Exception handling path: Resubmit with the missing attachment and supersede the incomplete submission reference.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Referral record holds the submitted package and a returned submission reference.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter referral record and the claim document repository referral folder.

steps.title: Attach the assembled package to the referral record in ClaimCenter
sop: Open the referral record and add the assembled package as an attachment.
Confirm each supporting exhibit is attached rather than only linked.
Record the package version identifier on the referral record.
Done when the package and its exhibits are attached with a version identifier.
verify: Attachment list on the referral shows the package and its exhibits.
Pass when the version identifier is recorded on the referral.

steps.title: Reconcile the attachment count to the completeness checklist
sop: Count attachments present on the referral record.
Compare the count against the completeness checklist item count.
Resolve any shortfall before submission.
Done when attachment count equals checklist item count.
verify: Counts are documented side by side in the claim diary note.
Pass when there is no unexplained difference between the two counts.

steps.title: Submit the package and capture the submission reference
sop: Press submit on the referral record in ClaimCenter.
Copy the returned submission reference onto the claim header.
Note the submission date and time in the claim diary.
Done when the submission reference is captured on the claim.
verify: Submission reference on the claim matches the value returned at submission.
Pass when the reference is non-blank and dated.

steps.title: File the submitted package version in the document repository
sop: Upload the exact submitted package version to the claim document folder.
Mark it as the submitted version so later drafts do not overwrite it.
Record the document id against the submission reference.
Done when the submitted version is filed and marked read-only.
verify: Repository holds a version marked as submitted with its upload timestamp.
Pass when the submitted version cannot be overwritten by a later draft.

steps.title: Confirm SIU can open every attachment
sop: Open each attachment on the submitted referral from the SIU side.
Report any file that is corrupt, empty or access restricted.
Record the readability check outcome on the referral.
Done when every attachment has been opened and confirmed readable.
verify: Check outcome lists each attachment and its readable status.
Pass when no attachment is unreadable or inaccessible to SIU.

steps.title: Log any failed attachment and its retry outcome
sop: Record any attachment that failed to upload or was reported unreadable.
Retry the upload and record the retry result.
Where the retry fails, escalate to the claims supervisor.
Done when every failed attachment has a recorded retry outcome.
verify: Exception log lists each failure with its disposition.
Pass when no unresolved attachment failure remains on the referral.

generic.Defined scope/population: Referrals sitting in the SIU intake queue awaiting triage and priority tier assignment.
generic.In-scope period: From queue arrival to tier assignment, within the intake triage service window.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Priority tier, target completion date and triage rationale populated on the FRISS case.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Referrals triaged in the period equals referrals that arrived in the intake queue.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Triage note retained on the case with the triaging manager and the triage timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Referrals returned to claims at triage logged with the return reason.
generic.Test population: All referrals triaged in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a triaged case has no priority tier value or no rationale note.
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate contested tiers to the SIU manager review forum and record the outcome.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Case carries a priority tier value with a rationale naming the deciding factors.
generic.Evidence location: FRISS case triage panel and the tier write-back on the ClaimCenter claim header.

steps.title: Score the referral on exposure value in FRISS
sop: Read the claim reserve and paid-to-date figures from the linked claim.
Score the exposure band using the SIU triage scoring guide.
Record the exposure score on the FRISS triage panel.
Done when the exposure score is recorded on the case.
verify: Exposure score references the claim financial figures used.
Pass when the score falls in a defined band on the scoring guide.

steps.title: Score indicator strength from the referral rationale
sop: Read the red-flag rationale and judge how strongly each indicator is evidenced.
Score indicator strength using the triage scoring guide.
Record which indicators drove the score.
Done when the indicator strength score and its drivers are recorded.
verify: Score names the indicators that drove it.
Pass when indicator strength is scored for every triaged referral.

steps.title: Assess organised-ring linkage using FRISS link output
sop: Review any link analysis output already attached to the referral.
Note connections to known rings, repeat providers or clustered claims.
Record the linkage assessment for the manager triage decision.
Done when the organised-ring linkage assessment is recorded.
verify: Assessment cites the link analysis output or states none was available.
Pass when the linkage assessment is present before tier assignment.

steps.title: Assign the priority tier on the FRISS case
sop: Combine exposure, indicator strength and ring linkage into a tier decision.
Set Tier 1 major or organised, Tier 2 standard, or Tier 3 desk review.
Save the tier value on the FRISS case header.
Done when a priority tier value is saved on the case.
verify: Tier value is one of the controlled tier options.
Pass when no triaged case is left without a tier value.

steps.title: Set the target investigation completion date from the tier SLA
sop: Look up the SLA duration for the assigned tier.
Calculate the target completion date from the triage date.
Save the target date on the case header.
Done when the tier-driven target completion date is saved.
verify: Target date equals triage date plus the tier SLA duration.
Pass when a target completion date exists on every triaged case.

steps.title: Record the tier rationale and write the tier back to ClaimCenter
sop: Write the triage rationale naming the deciding factors on the case.
Confirm the tier and target date write back to the originating claim.
Notify the handling adjuster of the tier through the claim system.
Done when rationale is recorded and the tier is visible on the claim.
verify: Rationale note names exposure, indicator strength and linkage findings.
Pass when the tier shown on the claim matches the tier on the FRISS case.

generic.Defined scope/population: Licensed investigators on the roster eligible for this case by loss state and case specialty.
generic.In-scope period: Licence validity must cover the assignment date through the target completion date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Assignment record holds investigator name, licence number, licence expiry and specialty tag.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Assigned caseload count per investigator stays within the tier caseload cap.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Licence check note retained on the case with the check date and licence expiry.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Assignments made over the caseload cap logged with the manager justification.
generic.Test population: All investigation assignments made in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if licence expiry precedes the assignment date or licence does not cover the loss state.
generic.Exception handling path: Reassign to an alternative licensed investigator or engage a licensed external vendor.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Assigned investigator holds an active licence covering the loss state at assignment.
generic.Evidence location: FRISS case assignment record and the assignment write-back on the ClaimCenter claim.

steps.title: Filter the investigator roster by loss state in FRISS
sop: Read the loss state from the linked claim header.
Filter the FRISS investigator roster to those licensed in that state.
Exclude any investigator without a state licence record.
Done when a state-eligible investigator shortlist is produced.
verify: Every shortlisted investigator holds a licence record for the loss state.
Pass when the shortlist is non-empty or an escalation is raised.

steps.title: Confirm licence status and expiry for shortlisted investigators
sop: Open each shortlisted licence record and read status and expiry date.
Remove any investigator whose licence expires before the target completion date.
Record licence number and expiry for the retained candidates.
Done when licence status and expiry are confirmed for the shortlist.
verify: Licence expiry recorded is on or after the assignment date.
Pass when no candidate with a lapsed licence remains on the shortlist.

steps.title: Match the case type to the investigator specialty tag
sop: Classify the case as arson, medical provider, staged auto or premium fraud.
Filter the shortlist to investigators carrying the matching specialty tag.
Record the case type and the specialty match on the case.
Done when the shortlist is filtered to the matching specialty.
verify: Case type recorded matches the referral rationale content.
Pass when the selected investigator carries the matching specialty tag.

steps.title: Check current caseload against the tier caseload cap
sop: Read the open case count for each remaining candidate in FRISS.
Compare each count against the caseload cap for the case tier.
Exclude candidates at or above the cap unless a justification is recorded.
Done when caseload capacity is confirmed for the chosen investigator.
verify: Open case count is captured for the investigator selected.
Pass when the count is within cap or an over-cap justification is recorded.

steps.title: Assign the investigation on the FRISS case
sop: Set the selected investigator on the FRISS case assignment field.
Record licence number and expiry checked at assignment in the case note.
Set the case status to Assigned with the assignment timestamp.
Done when the case shows the assigned investigator and licence details.
verify: Case note holds licence number and expiry as checked on the assignment date.
Pass when case status reads Assigned with a named investigator.

steps.title: Confirm geographic coverage with the field investigator
sop: Review the loss location and confirm the territory is workable for site visits.
Raise travel or coverage constraints back to the SIU manager.
Record the coverage confirmation as a FRISS case note.
Done when field coverage for the loss location is confirmed or challenged.
verify: Coverage note names the loss location and the covering field resource.
Pass when no unresolved coverage gap remains on the case.

generic.Defined scope/population: The triaged referral awaiting allocation to a qualified SIU investigator with no conflict of interest.
generic.In-scope period: From triage completion to assignment, within the tier allocation service window.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Case status, assigned investigator, conflict check outcome and assignment timestamp populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Triaged referrals equals assigned cases plus referrals returned to claims.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Assignment record retained with the assigning manager and the assignment timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Conflicts identified logged with the reallocation decision recorded.
generic.Test population: All triaged referrals allocated in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a case is Assigned without a completed conflict check.
generic.Exception handling path: Reallocate to an unconflicted investigator or refer to an external SIU vendor.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Case status is Assigned with a named investigator and an assignment timestamp.
generic.Evidence location: FRISS case assignment panel and the assignment note on the ClaimCenter claim.

steps.title: Open the triaged referral in FRISS
sop: Open the referral showing tier and triage rationale in FRISS.
Confirm triage is complete and a target completion date is set.
Return the referral to triage where either is missing.
Done when a fully triaged referral is open for allocation.
verify: Referral shows a tier value and a target completion date.
Pass when no untriaged referral proceeds to allocation.

steps.title: Select an investigator whose skills match tier and case type
sop: Match the case type and tier against the investigator skill profile.
Prefer an investigator with prior experience of the scheme type.
Record the skills match reasoning on the case.
Done when a candidate investigator is selected with recorded reasoning.
verify: Selection note names the tier and case type matched.
Pass when the candidate holds the skills recorded as required.

steps.title: Run the conflict check against insured, claimant and providers
sop: Check the candidate has no personal or prior professional relationship to the parties.
Check the candidate did not handle the underlying claim or a related case.
Record the conflict check outcome and date on the FRISS case.
Done when a conflict check outcome is recorded for the candidate.
verify: Conflict check names insured, claimant and providers as checked parties.
Pass when the outcome reads no conflict or a reallocation is made.

steps.title: Set the case status to Assigned in FRISS
sop: Set the assigned investigator on the case record.
Change the case status to Assigned.
Confirm the assignment timestamp is stamped automatically.
Done when the case reads Assigned with a named investigator and timestamp.
verify: Case status field reads Assigned.
Pass when investigator name and assignment timestamp are both present.

steps.title: Notify the investigator through the FRISS case system
sop: Trigger the in-system assignment notification to the investigator.
Avoid relying on email alone so the notification is auditable.
Confirm the notification appears on the investigator worklist.
Done when the in-system assignment notification has issued.
verify: Notification record exists on the case with a sent timestamp.
Pass when the case appears on the assigned investigator worklist.

steps.title: Write the assignment back to the claim in ClaimCenter
sop: Confirm the assignment date and investigator name reach the originating claim.
Add a claim note so the adjuster can see who holds the SIU case.
Correct the write-back where fields are blank on the claim.
Done when the claim shows the assigned investigator and assignment date.
verify: Claim note names the investigator and the assignment date.
Pass when claim and FRISS show the same assigned investigator.

generic.Defined scope/population: The full claim file and referral rationale for this case reviewed for referral validity and investigation scope.
generic.In-scope period: Policy period covering the loss date including reinstatements and endorsements near the loss.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Review note holds validity conclusion, scope statement and coverage in-force confirmation.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Red flags cited in the referral equals red flags evidenced by a document in the file.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Initial file review note retained on the case with the reviewer name and review date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Referrals returned to claims logged with the additional documentation that would make them referable.
generic.Test population: All accepted referrals subject to initial file review in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any cited red flag has no supporting document in the claim file.
generic.Exception handling path: Return to claims with a documentation request or decline with a recorded basis.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Case carries an initial file review note with a validity conclusion and scope statement.
generic.Evidence location: FRISS case review note plus source documents in the claim document repository.

steps.title: Read the FNOL and loss description in ClaimCenter
sop: Open the FNOL and the loss description on the claim.
Note the reported sequence, date, time, location and parties present.
Record any internal inconsistency in the reported account.
Done when the reported loss account is summarised with noted inconsistencies.
verify: Summary reflects the FNOL content held in ClaimCenter.
Pass when each noted inconsistency cites the document it came from.

steps.title: Review any recorded statement from the document repository
sop: Retrieve the recorded statement transcript where one exists.
Compare the statement account against the FNOL narrative.
Record any divergence between the two accounts.
Done when the statement has been compared against the FNOL.
verify: Comparison names both source documents by repository id.
Pass when divergences are listed or the absence of a statement is recorded.

steps.title: Verify coverage in force on the loss date in ClaimCenter
sop: Check the policy status and coverage effective on the date of loss.
Identify any reinstatement, endorsement or coverage increase close to the loss.
Record the coverage position and any proximity finding on the case.
Done when coverage in force at the loss date is confirmed and recorded.
verify: Coverage confirmation cites the policy transaction history.
Pass when any endorsement within the proximity window is recorded.

steps.title: Test each cited red flag against a document in the file
sop: List each red flag cited in the referral.
Locate the supporting document for each and record its reference.
Mark any red flag that has no supporting document as unsupported.
Done when every cited red flag is marked supported or unsupported.
verify: Supported red flags each name a document reference.
Pass when no red flag is left untested against the file.

steps.title: Record the validity conclusion and investigation scope in FRISS
sop: State one conclusion of accept, return to claims or decline.
Where accepting, state the scope of investigation to be pursued.
Where returning, state exactly what documentation would make it referable.
Done when the validity conclusion and scope statement are saved on the case.
verify: Conclusion is one of accept, return to claims or decline.
Pass when an accept conclusion carries a scope statement.

steps.title: Confirm the review conclusion with the SIU manager in FRISS
sop: Read the review note and test the conclusion against the evidence cited.
Endorse, amend or reject the conclusion with a written reason.
Record the endorsement on the FRISS case.
Done when the manager has recorded an endorsement decision.
verify: Endorsement names the conclusion reviewed and the decision taken.
Pass when no case proceeds to planning without an endorsed conclusion.

generic.Defined scope/population: The claim-hold position and insured communication approach for the claim under SIU investigation.
generic.In-scope period: From investigation start until the hold is released or the state handling deadline is reached.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Hold decision, hold reason, hold review date and agreed communication wording recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Statutory status letters issued equals letters due across the hold period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Hold decision note retained on the claim with the decision date and deciding parties.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Holds extended past the review date logged with the extension reason and new review date.
generic.Test population: All claims placed on SIU hold during the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any statutory status-update letter is missed during the hold period.
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate to the claims supervisor where the hold risks breaching the handling deadline.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Claim carries a documented hold decision with reason and a dated review point.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter claim hold panel and correspondence log, cross-noted on the FRISS case.

steps.title: Agree the hold position with the handling adjuster in ClaimCenter
sop: Discuss whether the claim is held, partially paid or continues to be handled.
Weigh the investigation need against the claim-handling obligations.
Record the agreed position and its reason on the claim.
Done when the hold position and reason are recorded on the claim.
verify: Recorded position is one of hold, partial payment or continue.
Pass when the recorded reason references the investigation need.

steps.title: Set the hold flag and payment control in ClaimCenter
sop: Apply the agreed hold setting on the claim payment control.
Confirm partial payments allowed under the agreement remain possible.
Record the effective date of the hold on the claim.
Done when the payment control reflects the agreed hold position.
verify: Payment screen behaviour matches the agreed hold position.
Pass when the hold effective date is recorded on the claim.

steps.title: Agree the insured communication wording
sop: Draft neutral wording explaining that the claim is under review.
Ensure no wording states or implies that fraud is suspected.
Record the agreed wording on the claim for consistent use.
Done when agreed neutral wording is recorded on the claim.
verify: Agreed wording contains no allegation of fraud.
Pass when the wording is recorded and available to the adjuster.

steps.title: Confirm statutory correspondence continues on schedule
sop: List the statutory acknowledgement and status-update letters due in the hold period.
Confirm each remains scheduled despite the hold.
Record the schedule on the claim correspondence log.
Done when the statutory letter schedule is confirmed for the hold period.
verify: Correspondence log shows each due letter with its due date.
Pass when no statutory letter is cancelled because of the hold.

steps.title: Set the hold review date before the handling deadline
sop: Identify the state claim-handling deadline applicable to the claim.
Set the hold review date before that deadline.
Create the review diary so the hold cannot run open-ended.
Done when a hold review date earlier than the deadline is set.
verify: Review date precedes the recorded claim-handling deadline.
Pass when a review diary exists for the hold.

steps.title: Cross-note the hold agreement on the FRISS case
sop: Record the hold position, wording and review date on the FRISS case.
Link the note to the claim number so both files agree.
Flag any disagreement that remains unresolved with claims.
Done when the FRISS case carries the agreed hold position.
verify: FRISS note matches the hold position recorded in ClaimCenter.
Pass when no unresolved disagreement is left undocumented.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every jurisdiction with a notification nexus for this case including loss state and policy state.
generic.In-scope period: From the determination date through to the statutory notification deadline for each trigger.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Determination value, statute section cited and notification deadline recorded on the case.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Jurisdictions assessed equals jurisdictions with a nexus identified on the case.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Determination note retained on the case with the reporting matrix version and date checked.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Jurisdictions where the matrix is silent logged with the legal counsel direction obtained.
generic.Test population: All SIU cases assessed for law-enforcement notification in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the determination does not cite the statute section relied on.
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate ambiguous triggers to Legal Counsel and record the written direction on the case.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Case holds a required or not-required determination citing the governing statute.
generic.Evidence location: FRISS case determination note and the fraud reporting matrix entry in Archer GRC.

steps.title: Identify jurisdictions with a reporting nexus in FRISS
sop: List the loss state, policy state and any other state with a nexus to the case.
Record why each jurisdiction is in scope.
Save the jurisdiction list on the FRISS case.
Done when every in-scope jurisdiction is listed with a reason.
verify: Jurisdiction list covers loss state and policy state at minimum.
Pass when each listed jurisdiction has a stated nexus.

steps.title: Check the fraud reporting matrix in the GRC platform
sop: Open the fraud reporting matrix entry for each in-scope state in Archer GRC.
Read the mandatory law-enforcement and DOI notification triggers.
Record the matrix version consulted alongside each entry.
Done when matrix triggers are recorded for every in-scope state.
verify: Each state entry records the matrix version consulted.
Pass when no in-scope state is left unchecked.

steps.title: Assess case characteristics that force notification
sop: Assess whether the case involves arson, bodily injury staging or an organised ring.
Compare those characteristics against the matrix trigger conditions.
Record the assessment outcome against each trigger.
Done when the forcing characteristics have been assessed and recorded.
verify: Assessment names each characteristic considered.
Pass when every trigger condition has a recorded assessment.

steps.title: Obtain legal direction on ambiguous triggers
sop: Review triggers where the matrix is silent or states conflict.
Provide a written direction on whether notification is required.
Record the direction and its date on the FRISS case.
Done when a written legal direction exists for each ambiguous trigger.
verify: Direction names the state and the statutory basis relied on.
Pass when no ambiguous trigger is resolved without a legal direction.

steps.title: Record the required or not-required determination on the case
sop: State the determination as required or not required per jurisdiction.
Cite the statute section relied on for each determination.
Save the determination on the FRISS case record.
Done when a cited determination exists for every in-scope jurisdiction.
verify: Each determination cites a statute section rather than a general reference.
Pass when no determination is recorded without a citation.

steps.title: Diary the notification deadline and confirm with the SIU manager
sop: Capture the notification deadline for each required jurisdiction.
Set a case diary in advance of each deadline.
Confirm the determination and diaries on the FRISS case.
Done when deadlines are diaried and the determination is manager-confirmed.
verify: Each required notification has a diary dated before its deadline.
Pass when the manager confirmation is recorded on the case.

generic.Defined scope/population: All evidence targets and investigative steps needed to test the stated fraud hypothesis for this case.
generic.In-scope period: Plan drafted and approved within 5 days of case assignment.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Hypothesis, evidence targets, step owners, budget estimate and exit criteria populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Evidence targets listed equals indicators the plan sets out to test.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Plan document retained on the case with its version and the approval date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Planned steps later abandoned logged with the reason and the manager agreement.
generic.Test population: All SIU cases assigned in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the plan is unapproved or dated more than 5 days after assignment.
generic.Exception handling path: Where budget exceeds the tier allowance, escalate to the SIU manager for approval.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Case holds an approved written investigation plan dated within 5 days of assignment.
generic.Evidence location: FRISS case plan record and the plan document in the claim document repository.

steps.title: State the fraud hypothesis on the FRISS case plan
sop: Write the specific hypothesis the investigation will test.
Name the policy condition or statutory element the hypothesis would engage.
Avoid framing the hypothesis as a conclusion already reached.
Done when a testable hypothesis and its target element are recorded.
verify: Hypothesis names a policy or statutory element.
Pass when the hypothesis is stated as testable rather than concluded.

steps.title: List evidence targets against the indicators they test
sop: List statements, medical records, phone records, scene and surveillance as applicable.
Map each target to the indicator or hypothesis element it tests.
Drop targets that test nothing on the indicator list.
Done when every evidence target is mapped to an indicator.
verify: Every listed target names the indicator it tests.
Pass when no indicator central to the hypothesis lacks a target.

steps.title: Set the sequence, owner and budget for each step
sop: Order the steps so cheaper internal work precedes external vendor spend.
Name an owner for each step from the case team.

steps.title: File the drafted plan to the claim document repository

steps.title: Attach the approved plan under type Investigation Plan

Set the document type to Investigation Plan.
Confirm the version uploaded is the approved version.
Done when the approved plan is attached under the correct document type.
verify: Attached document type reads Investigation Plan.
Pass when the attached version matches the version approved.

steps.title: Populate the structured hypothesis and target fields in FRISS
sop: Enter the hypothesis into its structured case field.
Enter each evidence target as a separate structured entry.
Confirm the fields are reportable rather than free text buried in the PDF.
Done when hypothesis and targets are held in structured fields.
verify: Structured entries match the content of the attached plan.
Pass when target entries can be listed from the case report view.

steps.title: Populate the milestone fields on the case record

Check the milestones reconcile to the plan document.

steps.title: Link the case record to the originating claim number

Correct either side where the cross-reference is missing.
Done when case and claim cross-reference each other.
verify: Case shows the claim number and the claim shows the case number.
Pass when navigation works in both directions.

steps.title: File the plan copy in the claim document repository
sop: File a copy of the approved plan in the claim document repository.
Restrict access to SIU, compliance and legal roles.
Record the repository document id on the case.
Done when the plan copy is filed with restricted access.

Pass when the case references the repository document id.

steps.title: Confirm investigator and approver stamps on the case header
sop: Check the case header shows the assigned investigator and the plan approver.
Correct any blank or stale stamp on the header.
Record confirmation that the case record is complete.
Done when investigator and approver are both stamped on the header.
verify: Approver stamped is the manager who approved the plan.
Pass when neither header stamp is blank.

generic.Defined scope/population: The investigation hold flag and the reserve note issued to the claims handler for this claim.
generic.In-scope period: From hold issue until SIU releases the hold at case disposition.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Hold flag state, hold issue date, reserve note text and SIU case reference populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Reserve movements recorded on the claim reconcile to the reserve note rationale.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Reserve note retained on the claim with issue date and issuing investigator name.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Reserve movements made without the SIU note referenced logged and corrected.

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a reserve change above the approval threshold lacks manager approval.
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate to the claims supervisor where the adjuster declines to record the reserve movement.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Claim shows an active investigation hold and a reserve note referencing the SIU case.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter hold panel and reserve history, cross-referenced on the FRISS case.

steps.title: Set the investigation hold flag on the claim in ClaimCenter
sop: Apply the SIU investigation hold flag on the claim header.
Confirm indemnity payments now require an SIU release.
Record the hold issue date and the SIU case reference.
Done when the investigation hold is active on the claim.
verify: Payment attempt on the claim is blocked pending SIU release.
Pass when the hold record shows an issue date and case reference.

steps.title: Draft the reserve note against the fraud hypothesis in FRISS
sop: State the SIU view of exposure given the fraud hypothesis.

Keep the wording factual and free of conclusions about the claimant.
Done when the reserve note text is drafted on the FRISS case.
verify: Note distinguishes contested from uncontested exposure.
Pass when the note avoids asserting fraud as established.

steps.title: Send the reserve note to the handling adjuster in ClaimCenter
sop: Post the reserve note to the claim addressed to the handling adjuster.
Reference the SIU case number in the note.
Request the adjuster records the reserve position with the note as rationale.
Done when the reserve note is posted on the claim to the adjuster.
verify: Note appears on the claim with the SIU case number cited.
Pass when the note is addressed to the named handling adjuster.

steps.title: Record the reserve movement citing the SIU note
sop: Adjust the reserve in line with the agreed exposure view.
Cite the SIU reserve note as the rationale for the movement.
Save the movement so the audit trail links note and reserve.
Done when the reserve movement is recorded citing the SIU note.
verify: Reserve history entry references the SIU reserve note.
Pass when no reserve movement tied to SIU lacks that reference.

steps.title: Check approval on reserve changes above threshold
sop: Compare the reserve movement against the manager approval threshold.
Where above threshold, confirm the approval record exists.
Escalate for approval where it is missing.
Done when every above-threshold movement carries an approval.
verify: Approval record exists for each movement above threshold.
Pass when no above-threshold movement is unapproved.

steps.title: Cross-reference the hold and reserve note on the FRISS case
sop: Record the hold issue date and reserve position on the FRISS case.
Attach the reserve note text to the case record.
Set a diary for the hold review point.
Done when hold and reserve details are recorded on the FRISS case.
verify: FRISS case reserve entry matches the ClaimCenter reserve position.
Pass when a hold review diary exists on the case.

generic.Defined scope/population: Insured, claimant, witnesses, providers and repairers listed on the documented case scope note.
