generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each search request carries the SIU case number and a permissible purpose value.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Searches executed equals parties listed on the scope note with no extras.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Returned reports saved to the case file with the search run date and vendor reference.

generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Every search log entry carries a case number and a permissible purpose.
generic.Evidence location: LexisNexis Risk search log and the report set saved to the FRISS case file.

steps.title: Record the party scope note on the FRISS case
sop: List insured, claimant, witnesses, providers and repairers to be searched.
Record why each party is within the investigation scope.
Save the scope note before any search is ordered.
Done when the party scope note is saved on the case.
verify: Each listed party carries a documented reason for inclusion.
Pass when the scope note predates the first search request.

steps.title: Order identity and public records checks in LexisNexis Risk
sop: Order identity verification and public records searches for the scoped parties.
Enter the SIU case number and permissible purpose on each request.
Record the request reference returned for each search.
Done when identity and public records searches are ordered and referenced.
verify: Every request shows a case number and permissible purpose.
Pass when request references are recorded for each ordered search.

steps.title: Order bankruptcy, lien and corporate registration checks
sop: Order bankruptcy, lien and corporate registration searches for the scoped parties.
Focus corporate searches on providers, repairers and public adjusters.
Record request references and expected return dates.
Done when financial and corporate checks are ordered for scoped parties.
verify: Corporate searches cover every commercial party on the scope note.
Pass when each order carries a recorded expected return date.

steps.title: Pull prior claims history from the enterprise data warehouse
sop: Query the warehouse for prior claims involving the scoped parties.
Restrict the query to the agreed coverage period.
Export the result set with the query run date.
Done when the prior claims history extract is produced.
verify: Extract covers the coverage period stated in the plan.
Pass when the extract row count is recorded with the run date.

steps.title: Save returned reports to the case file rather than the vendor portal
sop: Download each returned report from the vendor portal.
Save the reports to the FRISS case file with their run dates.
Record the vendor reference against each saved report.
Done when every returned report is saved to the case file.
verify: Case file report count equals the count of completed searches.
Pass when no completed report remains only in the vendor portal.

steps.title: Reconcile the search log against the documented scope
sop: List every search executed against this case number.
Compare that list against the party scope note.
Investigate and record any search against an unscoped party.
Done when the search log is reconciled to the scope note.
verify: Reconciliation shows searched parties matching scoped parties.
Pass when no search exists against a party absent from the scope note.

generic.Defined scope/population: Referrals arriving in the SIU intake queue requiring case creation and acknowledgement.

generic.Required fields populated and valid: All mandatory referral fields populated before the SIU case record is created.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Cases created equals referrals accepted from the intake queue for the period.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Case creation record retained with the creating user and the creation timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Referrals returned for missing mandatory fields logged with the fields requested.

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a created case is not linked to an originating claim number.

generic.Documented acceptance criteria: SIU case record exists with a case number linked to the originating claim number.
generic.Evidence location: FRISS SIU case record and the case number write-back on the ClaimCenter claim.

steps.title: Open the SIU intake queue in FRISS
sop: Open the SIU intake queue filtered to Awaiting triage.
Order referrals by submission timestamp so the oldest is handled first.
Select the referral to be intaken.

Pass when the queue is worked in submission order.

steps.title: Confirm mandatory referral fields are populated
sop: Check claim number, loss state, indicators and approval reference are present.

Record the completeness check outcome.
Done when the referral is confirmed complete or returned with named gaps.
verify: Completeness check covers every mandatory intake field.
Pass when no case is created from a referral with blank mandatory fields.

steps.title: Create the SIU case record and capture the case number
sop: Create the SIU case from the accepted referral in FRISS.
Capture the generated SIU case number.
Record the case creation timestamp and creating user.
Done when the SIU case record exists with a captured case number.
verify: Case number is generated and recorded on the case.
Pass when the creation timestamp and user are stamped.

steps.title: Write the SIU case number back to the claim in ClaimCenter
sop: Enter the SIU case number onto the originating claim record.
Confirm the claim now cross-references the SIU case.
Correct any write-back failure before proceeding.
Done when the claim carries the SIU case number.
verify: Case number on the claim matches the FRISS case number.
Pass when no created case is left unlinked to a claim.

steps.title: Acknowledge receipt to the referring examiner
sop: Issue the intake acknowledgement from the FRISS case.
Include the SIU case number and the acceptance timestamp.
Confirm the acknowledgement reaches the referring examiner worklist.
Done when the acknowledgement has issued to the referring examiner.
verify: Acknowledgement record shows recipient and sent timestamp.
Pass when the referring examiner can see the acknowledgement on the claim.

steps.title: Review the intaken referral for immediate investigative needs
sop: Read the intaken referral for perishable evidence or urgent scene needs.

Done when urgent investigative needs are flagged or confirmed absent.
verify: Review note states whether perishable evidence exists.
Pass when any urgent need carries an owner and a date.

generic.Defined scope/population: All investigation milestones required by the approved plan for this case plus the tier target date.
generic.In-scope period: From assignment date to the tier SLA target completion date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Target completion date and each milestone due date populated on the case header.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Milestone diaries created equals milestones defined on the case.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Milestone schedule retained on the case with the setting user and set date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Milestones rescheduled logged with the slippage reason and the new date.

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the case header lacks a target completion date or has fewer than three milestones.
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate to the SIU manager where a milestone would breach a statutory reporting deadline.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Case header holds a target completion date and at least three dated milestones.
generic.Evidence location: FRISS case milestone panel and the SIU diary entries on the ClaimCenter claim.

steps.title: Derive the target completion date from the tier SLA
sop: Read the priority tier and its SLA duration from the case.
Calculate the target completion date from the assignment date.
Record the target date on the FRISS case header.
Done when a tier-derived target completion date is on the case header.
verify: Target date equals assignment date plus the tier SLA duration.
Pass when the case header target date is non-blank.

steps.title: Set dated milestones for statements and record collection
sop: Set a milestone date for statements taken from claimant and witnesses.
Set a milestone date for third-party records received.
Sequence both before the target completion date.
Done when statement and records milestones carry dates.
verify: Both milestone dates fall before the target completion date.
Pass when each milestone names its deliverable.

steps.title: Set milestones for vendor reports and findings drafting
sop: Set a milestone for vendor and expert reports returned.
Set a milestone for the findings report drafted.
Allow review time between drafting and target completion.
Done when vendor report and drafting milestones carry dates.
verify: Drafting milestone leaves review time before target completion.
Pass when at least three dated milestones now exist on the case.

steps.title: Create diary activities for each milestone in FRISS
sop: Create a diary activity for each defined milestone.
Set the owner and the due date on each diary.
Confirm the diaries surface on the SIU workload report.
Done when every milestone has a matching diary activity.
verify: Diary count equals milestone count on the case.
Pass when each diary appears on the SIU workload report.

steps.title: Flag milestones that risk a statutory reporting deadline
sop: Compare milestone dates against recorded statutory reporting deadlines.
Flag any milestone that would push work past a deadline.
Record the flag and the mitigation proposed on the case.
Done when deadline-risk milestones are flagged with a mitigation.
verify: Comparison references the recorded reporting deadlines.
Pass when each flagged milestone carries a mitigation.

steps.title: Confirm the schedule with the SIU manager and sync to ClaimCenter
sop: Review the milestone schedule against the tier SLA and case complexity.
Approve or amend the schedule with a written reason.
Confirm the target date is visible to the adjuster on the claim.
Done when the manager has approved the schedule and it shows on the claim.
verify: Approval note names the schedule version reviewed.
Pass when the target completion date is visible on the ClaimCenter claim.

generic.Defined scope/population: All documentary, digital, medical and financial evidence collected on this case for analysis.
generic.In-scope period: Pre-loss financial window through the treatment period following the reported loss date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each discrepancy recorded with the exhibit reference and the source system it came from.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Exhibits analysed equals exhibits listed on the case evidence index.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Analysis note retained on the case with the analysis date and analyst name.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Evidence that could not be analysed logged with the reason and its impact on conclusions.
generic.Test population: All evidence items indexed on the case at the point of analysis.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any recorded discrepancy has no exhibit reference.
generic.Exception handling path: Where a data source is unavailable, record the gap and note its effect on the hypothesis.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Analysis note lists each discrepancy with an exhibit reference.
generic.Evidence location: FRISS case analysis note, the evidence index and the source extracts in the data warehouse.

steps.title: Build the loss timeline from case documents
sop: Extract dated events from FNOL, statements, invoices and reports.
Order them into a single loss timeline in the case analysis note.
Reference the exhibit that evidences each timeline entry.
Done when a referenced loss timeline exists on the case.
verify: Every timeline entry names its exhibit reference.
Pass when the timeline covers pre-loss through claim reporting.

steps.title: Compare the timeline against the claimant reported sequence
sop: Place the claimant reported sequence beside the evidenced timeline.
Mark each point where the two diverge.
Record the divergence with both source references.
Done when every divergence between the accounts is recorded.
verify: Each divergence names the reported and the evidenced version.
Pass when no divergence is recorded without both sources.

steps.title: Reconcile medical treatment dates and billing codes
sop: Compare treatment dates and billing codes against the reported injury mechanism.
Flag treatments inconsistent with the mechanism or predating the loss.
Record each flag with the billing exhibit reference.
Done when medical records are reconciled to the injury mechanism.
verify: Each medical flag names the billing exhibit it derives from.
Pass when the full treatment date range has been reviewed.

steps.title: Trace financial records in the enterprise data warehouse
sop: Query the warehouse for prior payments and duplicate claim payments.
Review supplied financial records for pre-loss distress or unusual transfers.
Record findings with the query run date and record counts.
Done when financial tracing findings are recorded with counts.
verify: Query output row counts are recorded alongside the findings.
Pass when duplicate payment checks are evidenced in the note.

steps.title: Check digital records against the stated time and place of loss
sop: Review telematics or EDR data, phone location data and photo EXIF.
Compare each against the stated loss time and location.
Record agreement or conflict with the exhibit reference.
Done when each digital source is compared and the outcome recorded.
verify: Each digital finding names the exhibit and its capture date.
Pass when every available digital source has been checked.

steps.title: Record the discrepancy schedule and review it with the SIU manager
sop: Consolidate all discrepancies into a single schedule on the case.
Test each entry for an exhibit reference and an innocent explanation.
Record the manager review outcome on the analysis note.
Done when the discrepancy schedule is complete and manager reviewed.
verify: Every schedule entry carries an exhibit reference.
Pass when the manager review outcome is recorded on the case.

generic.Defined scope/population: Every documentary and digital exhibit on the case evidence index requiring authentication.
generic.In-scope period: From exhibit collection until the authentication result is recorded on the index.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each exhibit carries an authentication method, source verified and result value.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Exhibits authenticated plus exhibits marked unverified equals total exhibits on the index.

generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Exhibits that cannot be authenticated marked unverified with the reason recorded.

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if an exhibit is marked authenticated without a recorded source verification.
generic.Exception handling path: Request a certified copy direct from the issuing source before relying on the exhibit.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Every exhibit in the index carries an authentication method and a result.
generic.Evidence location: Claim document repository exhibit records and the FRISS case evidence index.

steps.title: List exhibits requiring authentication from the FRISS evidence index
sop: Open the case evidence index and list all documentary and digital exhibits.
Mark which exhibits were supplied by the claimant rather than a source.
Prioritise claimant-supplied exhibits for source verification.
Done when the authentication work list is produced from the index.
verify: Work list covers every exhibit on the evidence index.
Pass when claimant-supplied exhibits are identified separately.

steps.title: Obtain certified copies direct from issuing sources
sop: Request certified or verified copies from the issuing provider or authority.
File the certified copy against the exhibit in the document repository.
Record the source, request date and receipt date on the exhibit.
Done when certified copies are held for source-verifiable exhibits.
verify: Each certified copy names the issuing source and receipt date.
Pass when no reliance is placed solely on a claimant-supplied copy.

steps.title: Compare invoices and estimates against vendor records
sop: Contact the vendor and request their own record for the invoice or estimate.
Compare document number, date and amount against the claimant-supplied copy.
Record any difference with both versions referenced.
Done when each invoice or estimate is compared to the vendor record.
verify: Comparison records both the supplied and the vendor figures.
Pass when every invoice above the review threshold has been compared.

steps.title: Check metadata and EXIF on digital exhibits
sop: Inspect document metadata and photo EXIF for creation and edit history.
Note any exhibit showing edits after the reported loss date.
Record the metadata findings on the exhibit record.
Done when metadata has been inspected for every digital exhibit.
verify: Findings state creation date and any edit history observed.
Pass when no digital exhibit is left without a metadata check.

steps.title: Record hash values for digital exhibits in the repository
sop: Compute a hash value for each digital exhibit file.
Record the hash on the exhibit record in the document repository.
Confirm the hash is captured before any further handling.
Done when every digital exhibit carries a recorded hash value.
verify: Hash values are present for all digital exhibit files.
Pass when hashes were recorded at or before first transfer.

steps.title: Mark unauthenticated exhibits as unverified on the evidence index
sop: Mark any exhibit that could not be authenticated as unverified.
Record the reason authentication failed or was unavailable.
Note the effect of that gap on any conclusion relying on the exhibit.
Done when every unauthenticated exhibit is marked unverified with a reason.
verify: Index shows an authentication result against every exhibit.
Pass when unverified exhibits each carry a recorded reason.

generic.Defined scope/population: Physical items collected at the loss scene that are relevant to the reported loss mechanism.

steps.title: Photograph each item in place with a scale reference
sop: Photograph each item where it lies before it is touched or moved.
Include a scale reference and a wider context shot for each item.
Confirm capture timestamps are enabled on the device.
Done when every item is photographed in place with a scale.
verify: Each item has at least one in-place photograph with a scale.
Pass when photograph timestamps precede the collection time.

steps.title: Obtain written owner consent before removing any item
sop: Request written consent from the property owner for each item to be removed.
Record the consenting person, the items covered and the time given.
Leave items in place where consent is refused and record the refusal.
Done when written consent or a recorded refusal exists for every item.
verify: Consent form lists the items it covers.
Pass when no item was removed without a filed consent form.

steps.title: Bag, label and seal each collected item
sop: Bag each item separately to avoid cross-contamination.
Label with case number, item number, date, time and collector name.
Apply a numbered seal and record the seal number.
Done when every collected item is bagged, labelled and sealed.
verify: Each bag label carries case number, item number and collector name.
Pass when every item has a unique recorded seal number.

steps.title: Record GPS coordinates and in-scene location per item
sop: Capture GPS coordinates at the point each item was found.
Describe the exact location within the scene for each item.
Record both against the item on the field note.
Done when location data is recorded for every collected item.
verify: Coordinates and in-scene description exist for each item.
Pass when the locations are consistent with the scene sketch.

steps.title: Log every item into the FRISS evidence index the same day
sop: Create an evidence index entry for each item on the day of collection.
Populate item number, description, seal number, collector and location.
Reconcile the entry count against the items bagged at scene.
Done when all items are indexed on the collection day.
verify: Index entry count equals the count of bagged items.
Pass when all entries are dated the day of collection.

steps.title: Upload the scene photograph set to the document repository
sop: Upload the full scene photograph set with EXIF intact.
Link the photographs to the corresponding item index entries.
Confirm no photograph has been cropped or re-saved before upload.
Done when the photograph set is uploaded and linked to items.
verify: Uploaded photographs retain their original capture metadata.
Pass when every item index entry links to at least one photograph.

steps.title: Obtain a signed in-date authorisation from the claimant

File the signed authorisation to the case with its expiry date recorded.
Done when a signed in-date authorisation is filed on the case.
verify: Authorisation shows a signature, a date and an expiry.
Pass when no request is raised before the authorisation is filed.

steps.title: Issue record requests citing the authorisation reference
sop: Issue requests to providers, employers and repairers named in the plan.

Record the request date and expected response date in the request log.
Done when each planned record request has issued with a reference.
verify: Each request log entry names its authorisation reference.
Pass when no request was issued without citing an authorisation.

steps.title: Pull policy, premium and prior claims records from LexisNexis Risk
sop: Pull policy transaction and premium payment history from the systems of record.
Run the prior claims search in LexisNexis Risk with the case permissible purpose.
Save the outputs to the case with their run dates.
Done when policy, premium and prior claims records are on the case.
verify: Each output records a run date and the purpose code used.

steps.title: Capture digital sources listed in the plan
sop: Capture telematics or EDR data, phone records and public social content per the plan.
