Done when each planned digital source is captured with date and URL.
verify: Each digital capture records a date and a source reference.
Pass when no capture was made from a private account without authority.

steps.title: Log requested items with request and chase dates
sop: Create a log line for every requested item on the case.
Record the request date and set the chase date for each.
Update the log as records are received.
Done when the request log shows status for every requested item.
verify: Log shows outstanding items distinctly from received items.
Pass when every outstanding item has a future chase date.

steps.title: File received records to the claim document repository
sop: File each received record against the case with its receipt date.
Add it to the evidence index with the source that supplied it.
Record refusals or unavailable records with the reason given.
Done when every received record is filed and indexed.
verify: Filed record count reconciles to the request log received count.
Pass when every refusal carries a recorded reason.

generic.Defined scope/population: Scene visits authorised for this case under the policy inspection right or owner consent.
generic.In-scope period: From assignment to the property inspection deadline set for the case tier.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Visit date, authorisation basis, attendees, arrival and departure times recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Visits conducted equals visits authorised and notified on the case.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Field note and photograph set filed to the case on the day of the visit.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Aborted or refused visits logged with the reason and the follow-up action.
generic.Test population: All scene visits conducted on SIU cases in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a visit occurred with no recorded authorisation basis.
generic.Exception handling path: Where consent is refused on site, withdraw and escalate to the SIU investigator.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Case holds a scene visit field note with date, attendees and authorisation basis.
generic.Evidence location: FRISS case field note and the visit notification record on the ClaimCenter claim.

steps.title: Confirm the authorisation basis before attending
sop: Check the policy right-of-inspection clause applicable to the loss.
Where the clause does not apply, obtain written owner consent.
Record the authorisation basis on the FRISS case before travel.
Done when the authorisation basis for the visit is recorded.
verify: Recorded basis is either the policy clause or a written consent.
Pass when no visit is scheduled without a recorded basis.

steps.title: Notify the handling adjuster of the visit date in ClaimCenter
sop: Record the planned visit date on the claim.
Notify the insured where notification is required for the visit.
Confirm no claim-handling activity conflicts with the visit date.
Done when the visit date is notified and recorded on the claim.
verify: Claim note shows the visit date and who was notified.
Pass when required insured notification is evidenced.

steps.title: Attend within the property inspection timeframe
sop: Schedule the visit inside the inspection timeframe set from assignment.
Record the assignment date and the visit date for the interval check.
Escalate where the timeframe cannot be met.
Done when the visit occurs within the timeframe or an escalation is logged.
verify: Interval between assignment and visit is recorded on the case.
Pass when the interval is inside the timeframe or escalated.

steps.title: Record arrival, departure, attendees and site conditions
sop: Record arrival and departure times on the field note.
List every attendee present and their role.
Note weather and site conditions affecting the inspection.
Done when times, attendees and conditions are on the field note.
verify: Field note holds arrival and departure times.
Pass when all attendees are named with their roles.

steps.title: File the field note and photographs to the case the same day
sop: Upload the field note and photograph set to the FRISS case.
File on the day of the visit so recollection is contemporaneous.
Link the note to the authorisation basis record.
Done when note and photographs are filed on the visit day.
verify: Upload date equals the visit date.
Pass when the field note links to the recorded authorisation.

steps.title: Review the visit output against the investigation plan
sop: Read the field note against the evidence targets in the plan.
Identify targets not addressed by the visit.
Record whether a further visit is required and why.
Done when the visit output is reviewed against the plan targets.
verify: Review names each plan target the visit addressed.
Pass when any unaddressed target carries a follow-up decision.

generic.Defined scope/population: Claimants, insureds, providers, attorneys, repairers, addresses, phones and bank accounts connected to this case.
generic.In-scope period: Portfolio claims window agreed for link testing, covering open and closed claims.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each identified link records the shared identifier and the linked claim numbers.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Linked claims listed equals linked claims returned by the warehouse query.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Network diagram and linked-claim list attached to the case with the run date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Links dismissed as innocent logged with the explanation accepted and by whom.
generic.Test population: All entities loaded into the link tool for this case.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any asserted link lacks a named shared identifier.
generic.Exception handling path: Where a link cannot be tested, record it as unassessed rather than asserting significance.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Case holds network analysis output with a linked-claim list and validated-link commentary.
generic.Evidence location: FRISS case attachments plus the warehouse linked-claim extract and LexisNexis Risk results.

steps.title: Load the entity set into the FRISS link tool
sop: Load claimants, insureds, providers, attorneys and repairers into the link tool.
Add addresses, phone numbers and bank accounts held on the case.
Record the entity count loaded and the load date.
Done when the full entity set is loaded with a recorded count.
verify: Loaded entity count matches the entities held on the case.
Pass when all identifier types available are included.

steps.title: Enrich entities with LexisNexis Risk identifiers
sop: Run identity enrichment on the loaded parties in LexisNexis Risk.
Record the permissible purpose on each enrichment request.
Add returned alternate addresses and phones to the entity set.
Done when the entity set is enriched with returned identifiers.
verify: Each enrichment request records a permissible purpose.
Pass when returned identifiers are added to the case entity set.

steps.title: Query the warehouse for claims sharing the identifiers
sop: Query the enterprise data warehouse for claims sharing any case identifier.
Cover both open and closed claims within the agreed window.
Return the matched claim numbers with the matching identifier named.
Done when the linked-claim extract is produced with identifiers named.
verify: Extract row count is recorded with the query run date.
Pass when every matched claim names the identifier that matched.

steps.title: Test each apparent link for an innocent explanation
sop: Assess whether a shared address is a large multi-occupancy building.
Assess whether a shared clinic or repairer is simply the only local option.
Record the explanation accepted or rejected for each link.
Done when every apparent link carries an innocence assessment.
verify: Each dismissed link records the explanation accepted.
Pass when no link is carried forward without an assessment.

steps.title: Quantify linked exposure across connected claims
sop: Sum paid and reserved amounts across the retained linked claims.
Split the total by scheme type or provider where relevant.
Record the exposure figure and its calculation basis.
Done when linked exposure is quantified with a stated basis.
verify: Exposure figure reconciles to the claim financials queried.
Pass when the calculation basis is recorded with the figure.

steps.title: Attach the network diagram and linked-claim list to the case
sop: Export the network diagram and the retained linked-claim list.
Attach both to the FRISS case with the analysis run date.
Add commentary naming validated links and dismissed links.
Done when diagram, list and commentary are attached to the case.
verify: Attachment carries the analysis run date.
Pass when commentary distinguishes validated from dismissed links.

generic.Defined scope/population: Claimant and witness interviews authorised for this case and recorded under the applicable consent rule.
generic.In-scope period: From interview scheduling until the audio and transcript are filed within the recorded-statement timeframe.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Interview date, location, parties present, consent confirmation and recording reference captured.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Recordings held equals transcripts filed for the case.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Audio file and transcript retained on the case with interview date and upload timestamp.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Interviews declined or terminated early logged with the reason and next action.
generic.Test population: All recorded interviews conducted on the case in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any recording is held without a captured consent confirmation.
generic.Exception handling path: Where consent is refused, take a written statement instead and record the refusal.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Recorded statement and transcript attached to the case with the interview date.
generic.Evidence location: FRISS case recording record and the transcript in the claim document repository.

steps.title: Confirm the state consent rule before recording
sop: Determine whether the interview state requires one-party or all-party consent.
Record the rule identified and the source relied on.
Adjust the interview approach where all-party consent applies.
Done when the applicable consent rule is recorded on the case.
verify: Recorded rule names the state it applies to.
Pass when no recording is planned before the rule is recorded.

steps.title: Confirm the interview approach with Legal Counsel
sop: Review the planned questions where the interview may touch privileged matters.
Confirm whether counsel attendance is required.
Record the legal position and any question constraints on the case.
Done when the legal position on the interview is recorded.
verify: Legal note states whether counsel attendance is required.
Pass when any question constraints are recorded before the interview.

steps.title: Open the recording with the consent question and answer
sop: State date, time, location and every party present at the start of the recording.
Ask the express consent question and capture the answer on the recording.
Stop the interview where consent is refused and record the refusal.
Done when consent is captured on the recording or refusal is recorded.
verify: Recording opens with the date, time, location and parties present.
Pass when an express consent answer is audible on the recording.

steps.title: Work the prepared question set through the loss sequence
sop: Cover the loss sequence, prior damage and financial circumstances.
Ask open questions before closed ones to avoid leading the account.
Note where the interviewee declines to answer.
Done when the prepared question set has been worked in full.
verify: Transcript shows each prepared topic was covered.
Pass when declined questions are noted in the transcript.

steps.title: Put each documented discrepancy to the interviewee
sop: Read out each documented discrepancy in neutral terms.
Record the explanation given for each without challenge on the record.
Note discrepancies the interviewee could not explain.
Done when every documented discrepancy has been put and answered.
verify: Transcript contains an explanation entry for each discrepancy put.
Pass when no documented discrepancy was left unput.

steps.title: Upload the audio and transcript to the case
sop: Upload the audio file to the FRISS case with the interview date.
File the transcript in the claim document repository and link it to the case.
Complete the upload within the recorded-statement timeframe.
Done when audio and transcript are filed and linked.
verify: Transcript and audio reference the same interview date.
Pass when upload occurred within the recorded-statement timeframe.

generic.Defined scope/population: Specialist forensic resources required by the investigation plan and drawn from the approved SIU vendor panel.
generic.In-scope period: From engagement raising until the expected report date recorded on the case.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Vendor name, written scope, fee estimate, conflict check and expected report date recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Engagements raised equals engagements with a recorded fee estimate on the case.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Engagement scope document retained on the case with the issue date and version.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Off-panel engagements logged with the manager approval and the reason for the exception.
generic.Test population: All specialist engagements raised on SIU cases in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a specialist is engaged from outside the approved vendor panel without approval.
generic.Exception handling path: Where the fee exceeds the plan budget, obtain SIU manager approval before instructing.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Case holds a written engagement scope with vendor name and fee estimate.
generic.Evidence location: FRISS case engagement record and the vendor cost entry on the ClaimCenter claim.

steps.title: Select the specialist from the approved SIU vendor panel
sop: Open the approved SIU vendor panel and filter by required discipline.
Confirm current credentials and professional insurance for the candidate.
Record the panel reference for the selected vendor on the case.
Done when a panel vendor with current credentials is selected.
verify: Vendor selected appears on the approved panel list.
Pass when credentials and insurance are recorded as current.

steps.title: Draft the written engagement scope on the FRISS case
sop: State the specific questions the expert must answer.
List the materials that will be provided to the expert.
State the required report format and the expected report date.
Done when a written scope with named questions is on the case.
verify: Scope names the questions rather than a general instruction.
Pass when an expected report date is stated in the scope.

steps.title: Run the conflict check on the selected expert
sop: Check the expert has not acted for the claimant or the provider under review.
Check for prior engagements on connected claims.
Record the conflict check outcome and date on the case.
Done when a conflict check outcome is recorded for the expert.
verify: Conflict check names the parties checked against.
Pass when the outcome reads no conflict or an alternative vendor is chosen.

steps.title: Confirm the fee estimate against the plan budget
sop: Obtain a written fee estimate from the vendor.
Compare it against the budget line in the approved investigation plan.
Record the comparison outcome on the case.
Done when the fee estimate is recorded and compared to budget.
verify: Fee estimate figure is recorded on the engagement record.
Pass when any over-budget estimate is flagged for approval.

steps.title: Obtain SIU manager approval where the fee exceeds budget
sop: Review the scope and the fee estimate against the case tier and exposure.
Approve, reduce or reject the engagement with a written reason.
Record the decision on the FRISS case engagement record.
Done when an approval decision is recorded for over-budget engagements.
verify: Approval record names the fee figure approved.
Pass when no over-budget engagement proceeds without approval.

steps.title: Record the engagement and cost on the ClaimCenter claim
sop: Raise the vendor engagement against the claim in ClaimCenter.
Record the scope reference and the expected report date.
Set a diary for the expected report date.
Done when the engagement and its expected date are on the claim.
verify: Claim vendor record references the engagement scope.
Pass when a diary exists for the expected report date.

generic.Defined scope/population: Surveillance activity authorised on named parties to answer a specific documented factual question.
generic.In-scope period: The number of surveillance days expressly approved in the written authorisation.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Justification, approved days, approved budget, vendor name and briefing reference recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Days invoiced by the vendor equals days approved in the authorisation.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Authorisation, vendor log and footage index filed to the case with dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Blank or unexplained surveillance periods logged with the vendor explanation obtained.
generic.Test population: All surveillance engagements raised on SIU cases in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any surveillance invoice is paid without a matching prior written authorisation.
generic.Exception handling path: Where extra days are needed, obtain a fresh written authorisation before continuing.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Case holds a written surveillance authorisation naming the justification and approved days.
generic.Evidence location: FRISS case authorisation record and the footage index in the claim document repository.

steps.title: Document the factual question surveillance will answer
sop: State the specific factual question surveillance is intended to resolve.
Link the question to an indicator or hypothesis element in the plan.
Reject speculative surveillance with no defined question.
Done when the surveillance question is documented on the case.
verify: Question links to a plan element or indicator.
Pass when no surveillance proceeds without a documented question.

steps.title: Confirm the legal position with Legal Counsel
sop: Review the proposed surveillance against privacy constraints in the jurisdiction.
Confirm prohibited conduct that must appear in the vendor brief.
Record the legal position on the FRISS case.
Done when the legal position on the surveillance is recorded.
verify: Legal note names the jurisdiction and the constraints identified.
Pass when the constraints are carried into the vendor brief.

steps.title: Obtain written SIU manager authorisation with days and budget
sop: Review the documented question and the legal position.
Authorise a specific number of surveillance days and a budget figure.
Record the written authorisation on the FRISS case.
Done when a written authorisation with days and budget is on the case.
verify: Authorisation states the number of days and the budget approved.
Pass when the authorisation predates any surveillance activity.

steps.title: Brief the vendor in writing on prohibited conduct
sop: Issue a written brief naming the subject, question and approved days.
State prohibited conduct including trespass, pretext entry and private-space recording.
File the brief to the case and obtain vendor acknowledgement.
Done when the written brief is issued and acknowledged.
verify: Brief lists the prohibited conduct explicitly.
Pass when the vendor acknowledgement is filed on the case.

steps.title: Review returned footage and the vendor log for gaps
sop: Compare the vendor log hours against the footage supplied.
Identify blank or unexplained periods within charged hours.
Obtain a vendor explanation before accepting the invoice.
Done when all charged periods are accounted for in the log.
verify: Log hours reconcile to the footage index hours.
Pass when every unexplained period has a vendor explanation.

steps.title: File the authorisation, log and footage index to the case
sop: File the authorisation, vendor log and footage index in the document repository.
Link all three to the FRISS case surveillance record.
Confirm days invoiced equal days authorised before payment.
Done when the surveillance record is complete and reconciled.
verify: Days invoiced equal days on the written authorisation.
Pass when authorisation, log and footage index are all filed.

generic.Defined scope/population: Law enforcement and fraud bureau contacts required for this case in the relevant jurisdiction.
generic.In-scope period: From first agency contact until the criminal matter concludes or the case is closed.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Agency name, officer name, contact date, content shared and agency case number recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Contact log entries equal disclosures made to any agency on the case.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Contact log retained on the case with dates and the disclosure summary for each entry.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Disclosures made without prior counsel confirmation logged and escalated.
generic.Test population: All law-enforcement contacts recorded on SIU cases in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a disclosure is recorded without an agency, officer and content summary.
generic.Exception handling path: Where immunity coverage is unclear, hold the disclosure pending written counsel direction.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Case holds a law-enforcement contact log with agency, officer and disclosure summary.
generic.Evidence location: FRISS case contact log and the counsel direction in the legal matter management system.

steps.title: Identify the correct agency for the loss type and jurisdiction
sop: Determine whether the state fraud bureau, DA, NICB or local police is the right recipient.
Confirm the jurisdiction covering the loss location.
Record the identified agency and the reason on the FRISS case.
Done when the receiving agency is identified and recorded.
verify: Agency recorded matches the loss type and jurisdiction.
Pass when the selection reason is documented.

steps.title: Confirm disclosure limits with Legal Counsel
sop: Review what may be disclosed under the state fraud-reporting immunity provision.
State clearly what must not be shared without a subpoena or order.
Record the direction in the legal matter management system and on the case.
Done when the disclosure limits are recorded in writing.
verify: Direction cites the immunity provision relied on.
Pass when no disclosure is made before the direction is recorded.

steps.title: Issue the internal evidence-preservation instruction
sop: Issue an instruction that no in-scope material is purged during the criminal matter.
Cover the claim file, SIU case, recordings and vendor reports.
Confirm the legal hold flag is applied to the case record.
Done when the preservation instruction is issued and the hold is applied.
verify: Legal hold flag is visible on the case record.
Pass when the preservation instruction names the in-scope material.

steps.title: Log each agency contact on the FRISS case
sop: Record agency name, officer name and date for every contact.
Summarise what was shared and under what authority.
Attach any document handed over to the log entry.
Done when every contact has a complete log entry.
verify: Each entry names agency, officer, date and content shared.
Pass when no contact is recorded without a content summary.

steps.title: Record the agency case or incident number
sop: Request the agency case or incident number at first contact.
Record it on the FRISS case header.
Chase where the number is not issued at first contact.
Done when the agency reference is recorded or a chase is diaried.
verify: Agency reference field on the case is populated or a chase exists.
Pass when the reference matches the agency confirmation.

steps.title: Review the coordination position with the SIU manager
sop: Review the contact log and the counsel direction together.
Confirm each disclosure stayed within the recorded limits.
Record the review outcome on the case.
Done when the manager has reviewed and recorded the coordination position.
verify: Review outcome names each disclosure reviewed.
Pass when no disclosure is found outside the recorded limits.

generic.Defined scope/population: Forensic disciplines required by the case including cause and origin, digital forensics and questioned documents.
generic.In-scope period: From instruction issue until the expert report is received and filed on the case.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Discipline, instruction letter reference, expert CV, methodology and report date recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Expert reports filed equals expert instructions issued on the case.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Expert report, CV and instruction letter retained on the case with their dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Reports outside the expert declared competence logged with the remedial action taken.
generic.Test population: All forensic experts instructed on SIU cases in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if an expert report is filed without the instruction letter and expert CV.
generic.Exception handling path: Where the report omits methodology, return it to the expert before relying on it.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Expert report and expert CV are attached to the case with the instruction letter.
generic.Evidence location: FRISS case expert record and the report set in the claim document repository.

steps.title: Match the forensic discipline to the question
sop: Select cause and origin for fire, digital forensics for device data.
Select questioned documents where signatures are in issue.
Record the discipline chosen and the question it addresses.
Done when the discipline is matched to a recorded question.
verify: Discipline recorded corresponds to the question stated.
Pass when no expert is instructed without a stated question.

steps.title: Issue the instruction letter and provide the full evidence set
sop: Draft the instruction letter naming the questions and materials provided.
Include material that undermines the fraud hypothesis, not only supporting material.
File the instruction letter to the case with its issue date.
Done when the instruction letter is issued and filed.
verify: Materials list includes any exculpatory items held.
Pass when the instruction letter is filed with an issue date.

steps.title: Confirm chain of custody for items taken for testing
sop: Record the transfer of any item to the expert on the custody log.
Capture date, time, from-party, to-party and reason for the transfer.
Obtain the expert signature on receipt.
Done when every item sent for testing has a signed custody transfer.
verify: Custody log shows a signed transfer for each item sent.
Pass when no item reached the expert without a logged transfer.

steps.title: Review the returned report for methodology and competence
sop: Check the report states its methodology and the standards applied.
Check the opinion sits within the expert declared competence.
Return the report where either is missing or exceeded.
Done when methodology and competence have been checked.
verify: Report names its methodology and the standards applied.
Pass when the opinion does not exceed the declared competence.

steps.title: File the expert report and CV to the document repository
sop: File the expert report and CV against the case in the repository.
File reports that do not support the hypothesis on the same basis.
Link the filings to the instruction letter reference.
Done when report and CV are filed and linked to the instruction.
verify: Repository holds report, CV and instruction letter for each expert.
Pass when no adverse report has been withheld from filing.

steps.title: Review expert findings with the SIU manager in FRISS
sop: Read the expert findings against the investigation hypothesis.
Record where the findings support, undermine or are neutral to the hypothesis.
Decide whether further expert work is justified.
Done when the manager has recorded a findings review on the case.
verify: Review names each expert report considered.
Pass when adverse findings are explicitly addressed in the review.

generic.Defined scope/population: Insured, claimants, witnesses and third parties to be interviewed under a named legal authority.
generic.In-scope period: From authority establishment until the interview note and transcript are filed.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Legal authority relied on, interviewee, date, consent record and authority document reference.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Interviews conducted equals interview records holding a named legal authority.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Interview note, transcript and authority document filed together with the interview date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Interviews refused or adjourned logged with the reason and the next step decided.
generic.Test population: All interviews conducted on SIU cases in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if an examination under oath was conducted without a served demand letter on file.
generic.Exception handling path: Where cooperation is refused, escalate to Legal Counsel for a formal demand.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Each interview record names the legal authority relied on for that interview.
generic.Evidence location: FRISS case interview record and the authority documents in the claim document repository.

steps.title: Determine the legal authority for each interview
sop: Identify whether the policy cooperation clause, an examination under oath or consent applies.
Record the authority chosen against each planned interviewee.
Where no authority exists, treat the interview as voluntary only.
Done when every planned interview has a recorded legal authority.
verify: Each interviewee record names one legal authority.
Pass when no interview is scheduled without a recorded authority.

steps.title: Confirm service of the examination under oath demand
sop: Check the demand letter was served in the form the policy requires.
Confirm counsel is instructed to conduct or attend the examination.
File the served demand letter to the case with its service date.
Done when a served demand letter is on file for any examination under oath.
verify: Demand letter shows a service date and method.
Pass when no examination proceeds without a served demand on file.

steps.title: Open the interview with identification and purpose
sop: Identify yourself and the company at the start of the interview.
State the purpose of the interview in neutral terms.
Record the opening in the interview note or on the recording.
Done when identification and purpose are recorded at the opening.
verify: Opening record names the interviewer and the company.
Pass when the stated purpose avoids alleging fraud.

steps.title: Advise of recording and obtain consent on the record
sop: Advise the interviewee that the interview is being recorded.
Ask for consent and capture the answer on the record.
Stop recording where consent is refused and note the refusal.
Done when consent or refusal is captured on the record.
verify: Consent answer is captured in the recording or the note.
Pass when no recording continued after a refusal.

steps.title: Coordinate claim-side context with the claims examiner
sop: Supply the claim facts and outstanding coverage questions before the interview.
Flag any topic that must be handled by claims rather than SIU.
Record the coordination note on the case.
Done when claim-side context and constraints are recorded.
verify: Coordination note lists the claim topics supplied.
Pass when claims-only topics are marked as out of SIU scope.

steps.title: File note, transcript and authority document together
sop: File the interview note and transcript to the document repository.
File the authority document alongside them under the same case reference.
Record the interview date on all three filings.
Done when note, transcript and authority are filed together.
verify: All three filings share the case reference and interview date.
Pass when no interview record is missing its authority document.

generic.Defined scope/population: All physical and digital evidence items collected on this case requiring a custody record.
generic.In-scope period: From the moment of collection until final disposition is authorised at case closure.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Item number, description, collector, seal number, storage location and hash where digital.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Items in the physical evidence store equal items shown as held on the custody log.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Every transfer recorded with date, time, from-party, to-party, reason and both signatures.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Unaccounted items logged with the search undertaken and the outcome reached.
generic.Test population: All evidence items held on SIU cases in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any custody transfer entry is missing a receiving-party signature.
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate any break in the custody chain to the SIU manager for a documented decision.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Every item has an unbroken custody chain from collection to current holder.
generic.Evidence location: FRISS case custody log and the evidence records in the claim document repository.

steps.title: Create the custody record at the moment of collection
sop: Create a custody record as each item is collected.
Record item number, description, collector name and seal number.
Timestamp the record at the point of collection.
Done when every collected item has a custody record created at collection.
verify: Custody record timestamp matches the collection time.
Pass when no item exists without a custody record.

steps.title: Record every transfer with both signatures
sop: Record date, time, from-party, to-party and reason for each transfer.
Obtain signatures from both the releasing and receiving parties.
Refuse to release an item where a signature cannot be obtained.
Done when every transfer carries both signatures and a reason.
verify: Each transfer entry shows a receiving-party signature.
Pass when no transfer entry is left unsigned.

steps.title: Log storage location and hash values
sop: Record the physical storage location for each physical item.
Record the hash value and storage path for each digital item.
Update the record whenever storage changes.
Done when storage details are recorded for every item.
verify: Digital items each show a hash and a storage path.
Pass when physical items each show a current storage location.

steps.title: Reconcile the evidence store against the custody log
sop: Count items physically present in the evidence store.
Compare the count against items shown as held on the custody log.
Investigate and record any unaccounted item.
Done when store and log are reconciled with differences explained.
verify: Counts are documented with the reconciliation date.
Pass when every difference has a recorded explanation.

steps.title: Record the final disposition with authorisation
sop: Decide whether each item is returned, retained or destroyed.
Authorise the disposition in writing before it is actioned.
Record the disposition and authorisation on the custody log.
Done when every item has an authorised final disposition.
verify: Each disposition entry names the authorising manager.
Pass when no item is disposed of without prior authorisation.

steps.title: File the completed custody log to the document repository
sop: Export the completed custody log at case closure.
File it in the claim document repository under the case reference.
Confirm the filed log is read-only after transfer.
Done when the completed custody log is filed and locked.
verify: Filed log covers every item from collection to disposition.
Pass when the filed log cannot be edited after transfer.

generic.Defined scope/population: The loss scene and all damage areas relevant to testing the reported loss mechanism.
generic.In-scope period: The inspection visit date, with the report completed the same day.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Inspection date, measurements, mechanism test findings and photograph references recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Damage areas photographed equals damage areas listed on the inspection report.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Photograph set retained with EXIF intact and the inspection report dated the visit day.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Areas that could not be inspected logged with the reason and any follow-up planned.
generic.Test population: All scene inspections carried out on SIU cases in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the inspection report is not filed with a dated photograph set.
generic.Exception handling path: Where access is denied on site, record the refusal and escalate to the SIU investigator.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Scene inspection report and dated photograph set are attached to the case.
generic.Evidence location: FRISS case inspection record and the photograph set in the claim document repository.

steps.title: Photograph the overall scene and each damage area
sop: Take overall scene shots before approaching individual damage areas.
Take wide, medium and close shots of each damage area with a scale.
Confirm EXIF capture is enabled on the device.
Done when overall and per-area photographs are captured with scales.
verify: Each damage area has wide, medium and close shots.
Pass when photographs retain their capture metadata.

steps.title: Measure and sketch the scene
sop: Measure distances relevant to the reported loss mechanism.
Produce a sketch showing those measurements and orientation.
Record the measuring method used.
Done when a measured sketch of the scene exists.
verify: Sketch shows the measurements relevant to the mechanism.
Pass when the measuring method is recorded.

steps.title: Test the reported mechanism against the physical evidence
sop: Compare burn patterns, impact direction or forced-entry marks to the reported account.
Record where the physical evidence supports or contradicts the account.
Photograph each feature relied on for the comparison.
Done when the mechanism test findings are recorded with photographs.
verify: Each finding references the photograph that evidences it.
Pass when both supporting and contradicting features are recorded.

steps.title: Record pre-existing damage and staging indicators separately
sop: Note pre-existing damage distinctly from loss-related damage.
Note absent contents or arrangement suggesting staging.
Keep these observations factual and photograph each one.
Done when pre-existing and staging observations are recorded separately.
verify: Report separates pre-existing damage from loss damage.
Pass when each observation carries a photograph reference.

steps.title: Complete the inspection report the same day
sop: Write the inspection report while recollection is contemporaneous.
Include measurements, mechanism findings and observation list.
File it to the FRISS case on the day of the visit.
Done when the inspection report is filed on the inspection day.
verify: Report file date equals the inspection date.
Pass when the report includes measurements and mechanism findings.

steps.title: Attach the photograph set and review with the investigator
sop: Attach the full photograph set to the case with EXIF intact.
Review the report against the investigation plan targets.
Record whether further inspection work is required.
Done when photographs are attached and the report is reviewed.
verify: Photograph count on the case matches the count taken on site.
Pass when the review records any further inspection required.

generic.Defined scope/population: The draft SIU report and disposition recommendation for this case awaiting manager sign-off.
generic.In-scope period: From draft submission until the approval decision is recorded on the case.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Approval decision, rationale, approver identity and decision timestamp recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Conclusions in the report equal conclusions tied to a filed exhibit.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Approval note retained with the report version reviewed and the decision date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Amend or reject decisions logged with the specific changes required.
generic.Test population: All disposition recommendations submitted for approval in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the approver user id matches the report author user id.
generic.Exception handling path: Route to an alternative manager where segregation of duties would be breached.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Recommendation carries an SIU manager approval with a written rationale.
generic.Evidence location: FRISS case approval record and the disposition write-back on the ClaimCenter claim.

steps.title: Read the draft report and test conclusions against exhibits
sop: Read each conclusion in the draft report.
Trace each conclusion to a filed exhibit reference.
Mark conclusions that rest on no filed exhibit.
Done when every conclusion has been traced to an exhibit or flagged.
verify: Every conclusion is marked traced or flagged.
Pass when no untraced conclusion is left unflagged.

steps.title: Check exculpatory evidence has been addressed
sop: Identify evidence in the case file that undermines the hypothesis.
Confirm the report addresses rather than omits it.
Record where exculpatory material is missing from the report.
Done when exculpatory evidence handling has been checked.
verify: Check names each exculpatory item found in the file.
Pass when no exculpatory item is omitted without a reason.

steps.title: Confirm legal review for denial, rescission or prosecution
sop: Review the recommendation where it is denial, rescission or prosecution referral.
Confirm the evidentiary basis supports the recommended action.
Record the legal concurrence on the FRISS case.
Done when legal concurrence is recorded for those recommendations.
verify: Concurrence names the recommendation reviewed.
Pass when no denial or rescission proceeds without recorded legal review.

steps.title: Confirm the approver is not the case investigator
sop: Compare the approving manager against the report author.
Escalate to an alternative manager where they are the same person.
Record the segregation check on the case.
Done when the approver is confirmed distinct from the author.
verify: Approver user id does not equal the report author user id.
Pass when the segregation check outcome is recorded.

steps.title: Record approve, amend or reject with rationale in FRISS
sop: Select approve, amend or reject on the recommendation record.
Write the rationale naming the evidence relied on.
Where amending, list the specific changes required.
Done when the decision and rationale are saved on the case.
verify: Decision value is one of approve, amend or reject.
Pass when the rationale is non-blank and evidence-based.

steps.title: Write the approved disposition back to ClaimCenter
sop: Confirm the approved recommendation reaches the originating claim.
Check the claim shows the SIU recommendation and its approval date.
Notify the handling adjuster that the recommendation is approved.
Done when the approved recommendation is visible on the claim.
verify: Claim shows the recommendation matching the approved case record.
Pass when the adjuster notification is recorded on the claim.

generic.Defined scope/population: Each element of the fraud test scored against the reconciled evidence held on this case.
generic.In-scope period: Evidence collected up to the assessment date, including late-returned vendor reports.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Per-element scores, probability rating and further-evidence note recorded on the case.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Elements scored equals elements required by the fraud test being applied.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Assessment record retained on the case with the assessment date and assessor name.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Elements that cannot be scored logged with the missing evidence identified.
generic.Test population: All SIU cases reaching the assessment stage in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any scored element lacks an evidence reference.
generic.Exception handling path: Where evidence is inconclusive, rate the case suspicious rather than substantiated.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Case carries a fraud probability rating with a per-element evidence reference.
generic.Evidence location: FRISS case assessment record and the supporting extracts in the data warehouse.

steps.title: Score material misrepresentation against the evidence
sop: Identify each statement alleged to be a misrepresentation.
Score how strongly the evidence establishes it.
Record the exhibit reference beside each score.
Done when misrepresentation is scored with exhibit references.
verify: Each score names the exhibit relied on.
Pass when no misrepresentation score is unreferenced.

steps.title: Score intent, knowledge and reliance
sop: Score evidence of intent and knowledge separately from the misstatement itself.
Score reliance by the insurer on the statement made.
Record exhibit references for each element scored.
Done when intent, knowledge and reliance are each scored.
verify: All three elements carry a score and a reference.
Pass when no element is left unscored.

steps.title: Weigh contradicting and exculpatory evidence explicitly
sop: List evidence that contradicts the fraud hypothesis.
State how it affects each element score.
Record the weighting reasoning on the assessment.
Done when contradicting evidence is weighed and recorded.
verify: Assessment names each contradicting item considered.
Pass when the effect on scores is stated for each item.

steps.title: Corroborate scores against warehouse claim data
sop: Query the enterprise data warehouse for comparable case outcomes.
Test whether the element pattern matches previously substantiated cases.
Record the comparison and its limitations.
Done when the warehouse comparison is recorded on the assessment.
verify: Comparison records the query run date and population used.
Pass when limitations of the comparison are stated.

steps.title: Set the probability rating on the SIU scale
sop: Select unsubstantiated, suspicious or substantiated from the SIU scale.
Record what further evidence would move the rating.
Store the rating on the case rather than only in the narrative report.
Done when the probability rating and movement note are on the case.
verify: Rating is one of the controlled scale values.
Pass when the further-evidence note is recorded.

steps.title: Review the assessment with the SIU manager and counsel
sop: Review element scores, weighting and the resulting rating.
Obtain Legal Counsel input where the rating supports denial or prosecution.
Record the review outcome and any rating change on the case.
Done when the manager review outcome is recorded.
verify: Review names the rating reviewed and the outcome reached.
Pass when any rating change carries a written reason.

generic.Defined scope/population: All recovery routes available on this claim including restitution, civil action, subrogation and provider clawback.
generic.In-scope period: From findings completion until each route reaches its limitation date or is closed.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Route, quantified amount, limitation date and referral owner recorded on the claim.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Recovery referrals raised equals recovery routes identified as viable.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Recovery referral record retained with the evidence package reference and referral date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Routes rejected as non-viable logged with the reason recorded.
generic.Test population: All SIU cases with a quantified recoverable amount in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a signed release on file waives an identified recovery right.
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate to Legal Counsel where a release may already have waived a route.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Claim holds a recovery referral record with route, amount and limitation date.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter recovery referral record cross-referenced on the FRISS case.

steps.title: Identify every available recovery route
sop: List restitution order, civil action, third-party subrogation and provider clawback.
Mark each as viable or not viable for this case.
Record the reason for each non-viable route.
Done when every route is assessed and recorded.
verify: Assessment covers all four route types.
Pass when each non-viable route carries a reason.

steps.title: Quantify the amount attached to each viable route
sop: Pull paid-to-date and reserve figures from the claim financials.
Allocate the recoverable amount to each viable route.
Record the calculation basis alongside the figures.
Done when each viable route carries a quantified amount.
verify: Amounts reconcile to the claim financial records.
Pass when each amount shows its calculation basis.

steps.title: Record the limitation date for each route
sop: Identify the limitation or statute-of-limitations date per route and jurisdiction.
Record each date against the route on the claim.
Flag routes where the limitation date is close.
Done when a limitation date is recorded for each viable route.
verify: Each viable route shows a limitation date.
Pass when close-to-limitation routes are flagged.

steps.title: Check no signed release waives a recovery right
sop: Search the claim file for any signed release or settlement agreement.
Assess whether it waives any identified recovery route.
Record the outcome and escalate any waiver found.
Done when the release check is recorded for the claim.
verify: Check names each release document reviewed.
Pass when no identified route is waived by a filed release.

steps.title: Refer the file to subrogation with the evidence package
sop: Raise the recovery referral on the claim in ClaimCenter.
Attach the evidence package and the quantified amount.
Name the referral owner and the route referred.
Done when the recovery referral is raised with its evidence package.
verify: Referral record shows route, amount and evidence reference.
Pass when a named owner is recorded on the referral.

steps.title: Set the recovery tracking record and cross-note in FRISS
sop: Create the recovery tracking record so the amount is followed to closure.
Set a diary before each limitation date.
Cross-note the recovery position on the FRISS case.
Done when tracking, diaries and cross-notes are in place.
verify: Tracking record exists for each referred route.
Pass when every limitation date has a diary set before it.

generic.Defined scope/population: Each element required by the policy fraud or concealment condition for a denial or rescission recommendation.
generic.In-scope period: Policy period including any contestability window applicable to rescission.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Policy provision cited, statute cited, materiality finding and legal concurrence recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Elements mapped equals elements the policy condition requires to be proved.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Determination note retained with the policy version relied on and the determination date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Elements not evidenced logged with the effect on the recommended action.
generic.Test population: All cases considered for denial or rescission in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a denial or rescission recommendation carries no recorded legal review.
generic.Exception handling path: Where an element is unproven, recommend a lesser action rather than denial.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Case holds an evidentiary determination naming the policy provision and legal concurrence.
generic.Evidence location: FRISS case determination note plus the policy documents in the claim document repository.

steps.title: Retrieve the applicable policy wording from the document repository
sop: Retrieve the policy version in force at the date of loss.
Locate the fraud or concealment condition and its required elements.
File the wording extract to the case with its version reference.
Done when the applicable policy condition is on the case with a version.
verify: Wording retrieved matches the policy in force at the loss date.
Pass when the version reference is recorded on the extract.

steps.title: Map the evidence to each required element
sop: List each element the condition requires to be proved.
Map the exhibits that evidence each element.
Mark elements with no supporting exhibit as unproven.
Done when every element is mapped or marked unproven.
verify: Every element carries either exhibits or an unproven marker.
Pass when no element is left unmapped.

steps.title: Confirm materiality of the misrepresentation
sop: Assess whether the misrepresentation would have changed underwriting or the claim decision.
Record the basis for the materiality view including any underwriting reference.
State clearly where materiality cannot be established.
Done when a materiality finding is recorded with its basis.
verify: Materiality finding names the decision it would have changed.
Pass when the basis for the finding is documented.

steps.title: Check state rescission rules and the contestability window
sop: Check state rescission rules applicable to the policy and loss state.
Confirm whether the contestability window remains open.
Record the outcome and any procedural steps required.
Done when rescission rules and contestability are checked and recorded.
verify: Check names the state rules and the contestability position.
Pass when no rescission is recommended outside the window.

steps.title: Obtain written legal concurrence on the evidentiary standard
sop: Review the element mapping and the materiality finding.
Confirm in writing whether the evidentiary standard is met.
Record the concurrence and its date on the FRISS case.
Done when written legal concurrence is recorded on the case.
verify: Concurrence states whether the standard is met or not met.
Pass when it is dated and attributed to counsel.

steps.title: Record the determination with provision and statute cited
sop: State the determination on the FRISS case.
Cite the specific policy provision and the statute relied on.
Write the determination back to the claim in ClaimCenter.
Done when the cited determination is on the case and the claim.
verify: Determination cites both a policy provision and a statute.
Pass when the claim shows the same determination as the case.

generic.Defined scope/population: The full SIU investigation narrative covering background, steps, evidence, analysis and recommendation.
generic.In-scope period: All investigative activity from case assignment to the drafting date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Report sections complete with exhibit citations against every factual assertion.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Exhibit numbers cited in the report equal exhibits on the case evidence index.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Draft report retained on the case with its version number and drafting date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Assertions without an exhibit logged and either evidenced or removed from the draft.
generic.Test population: All SIU reports drafted in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any cited exhibit number is absent from the evidence index.
generic.Exception handling path: Where a required section cannot be completed, record the gap and its effect on conclusions.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Draft report exists with numbered exhibit citations matching the evidence index.
generic.Evidence location: FRISS case draft report record and the report file in the claim document repository.

steps.title: Write the report to the standard structure
sop: Use the sections background, investigation steps, evidence, analysis, conclusion and recommendation.
Keep each section to its purpose without duplicating content.
Populate every section before circulating the draft.
Done when all six standard sections are populated.
verify: All six standard sections are present in the draft.
Pass when no section is left as a placeholder.

steps.title: Cite an exhibit number for every factual assertion
sop: Add an exhibit citation beside each factual assertion.
Confirm each cited exhibit is attached to the case.
Remove or evidence any assertion with no exhibit.
Done when every factual assertion carries a valid exhibit citation.
verify: Cited exhibit numbers exist on the evidence index.
Pass when no assertion remains uncited.

steps.title: Include exculpatory findings and claimant explanations
sop: Record findings that undermine the fraud hypothesis.
Record the explanations the claimant gave for each discrepancy.
State how each was weighed in the analysis.
Done when exculpatory findings and explanations are included.
verify: Report names each exculpatory finding held on the case.
Pass when each claimant explanation is recorded.

steps.title: Remove characterisations and state elements instead
sop: Remove any wording characterising a party as a fraudster.
Replace it with the evidence and the element it meets.
Read the report through for tone before circulation.
Done when the report states evidence and elements rather than characterisations.
verify: No section labels a party as a fraudster.
Pass when conclusions are framed as elements met or not met.

steps.title: Run the redaction pass on third-party personal data
sop: Identify third-party personal data not required for the conclusion.
Redact it from the report and note the redaction was applied.
Retain the unredacted source in the evidence file only.
Done when the redaction pass is complete and noted.
verify: Redaction note states what categories were removed.
Pass when no unnecessary third-party personal data remains in the draft.

steps.title: Circulate the draft to the SIU manager in FRISS
sop: Read the draft for structure, citation completeness and tone.
Return specific amendments where the draft falls short.
Record the draft review outcome on the case.
Done when the manager has recorded a draft review outcome.
verify: Review outcome names the draft version reviewed.
Pass when required amendments are listed specifically.

generic.Defined scope/population: The final SIU investigation report and evidence index to be filed on the claim for audit.
generic.In-scope period: From report finalisation to filing, with retention starting from the file date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Document type, file date, SIU case cross-reference and access restriction recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Exhibits listed on the filed index equal exhibits held on the case.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Filed report retained with its version and file date in the claim document folder.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Exhibits withheld from the claim file logged with the reason for withholding.
generic.Test population: All finalised SIU reports filed in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the SIU report is visible in any policyholder-facing document view.
generic.Exception handling path: Correct permissions immediately and record the exposure where a report is wrongly visible.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Claim document folder contains the SIU investigation report typed and dated.
generic.Evidence location: Claim document repository SIU folder and the document record in ClaimCenter.

steps.title: Attach the final report under the correct document type
sop: Upload the final report to the claim document folder.
Set the document type to SIU Investigation Report.
Record the file date and the report version.
Done when the report is filed under the correct type with a date.
verify: Document type reads SIU Investigation Report.
Pass when version and file date are both recorded.

steps.title: Attach the evidence index alongside the report
sop: File the evidence index with the report in the same folder.
Confirm the index lists every exhibit held on the case.
Record any exhibit deliberately withheld with the reason.
Done when the evidence index is filed and reconciled.
verify: Index exhibit count equals the case exhibit count less withheld items.
Pass when every withheld exhibit carries a reason.

steps.title: Set access so audit and quality roles can read it
sop: Grant read access to claims audit and quality review roles.
Confirm SIU, compliance and legal roles retain access.
Record the access configuration applied.
Done when audit and quality roles can read the filed report.
verify: Access list includes audit and quality review roles.
Pass when the configuration is recorded on the document.

steps.title: Restrict the report from the insured-facing portal
sop: Confirm the document is excluded from policyholder-facing views.
Test the portal view to confirm the report does not appear.
Correct and record any exposure found.
Done when the report is confirmed hidden from the insured-facing portal.
verify: Portal view test shows no SIU report present.
Pass when any exposure found has been corrected and recorded.

steps.title: Cross-reference the SIU case number on the document record
sop: Enter the SIU case number on the claim document record.
Confirm the document is retrievable by case number.
Record the document id back on the FRISS case.
Done when the document and case cross-reference each other.
verify: Document record shows the SIU case number.
Pass when the case references the filed document id.

steps.title: Verify the retention clock started from the correct file date
sop: Check the retention metadata on the filed document.
Confirm the retention start date equals the file date.
Correct the metadata where the start date is wrong.
Done when the retention start date matches the file date.
verify: Retention start date equals the recorded file date.
Pass when retention metadata is present on the document.

generic.Defined scope/population: The findings conference covering the handling adjuster, claims supervisor and counsel where denial is in view.
generic.In-scope period: From findings approval until the agreed next action is recorded on the case.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Attendees, date, positions taken, agreed next action and its owner recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Attendees recorded equals attendees invited or the absence is noted.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Presentation note retained on the case with the meeting date and presenter name.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Challenges raised to the findings logged with the response recorded.
generic.Test population: All findings presentations held on SIU cases in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the presentation note has no agreed next action with a named owner.
generic.Exception handling path: Where the group disagrees, escalate to the SIU manager and record the escalation.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Case holds a findings presentation note listing attendees, date and agreed next action.
generic.Evidence location: FRISS case presentation note cross-referenced on the ClaimCenter claim.

steps.title: Book the findings conference with the required attendees
sop: Invite the handling adjuster and the claims supervisor.
Invite counsel where denial or rescission is in view.
Record the invitation list and the meeting date on the case.
Done when the conference is booked with the required attendees invited.
verify: Invitation list covers adjuster and supervisor at minimum.
Pass when counsel is invited for any denial-track case.

steps.title: Walk the group through the evidence
sop: Present the evidence in the order it was gathered.
Identify each exhibit by its index number as it is discussed.
Distinguish established facts from inference.
Done when the evidence has been presented with exhibit references.
verify: Presentation note lists the exhibits discussed.
Pass when inference is distinguished from established fact.

steps.title: Explain the policy provision engaged
sop: Explain the specific policy provision the evidence engages.
State what remains to be proved for the recommended action.
Record the legal position as presented.
Done when the engaged provision and remaining gaps are explained.
verify: Note names the policy provision explained.
Pass when remaining evidential gaps are recorded.

steps.title: Capture each attendee position and challenge
sop: Record the position each attendee takes on the findings.
Record any challenge raised to the evidence or conclusions.
Record the response given to each challenge.
Done when positions and challenges are captured for all attendees.
verify: Each attendee has a recorded position.
Pass when every challenge carries a recorded response.

steps.title: Record the agreed next action and owner in FRISS
sop: State the agreed next action arising from the conference.
Name the owner and the due date for that action.
Save the note on the FRISS case and cross-note the claim.
Done when the agreed next action, owner and date are recorded.
verify: Next action names an owner and a due date.
Pass when the claim carries the same next action.

steps.title: Mark counsel-directed content as privileged
sop: Identify the portion of the discussion directed by counsel.
Mark that portion as privileged in the case record.
Keep the privileged portion separate from the general note.
Done when counsel-directed content is marked privileged.
verify: Privileged content is stored under the privileged marker.
Pass when the general note contains no privileged content.

generic.Defined scope/population: Amounts paid and amounts avoided on this claim attributable to proven fraud or inflation.
generic.In-scope period: Claim financial transactions from first payment to the quantification date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Recoverable amount, avoided amount, calculation basis and reviewer identity recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Recoverable plus avoided amounts reconcile to the claim paid and reserve figures.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Calculation working attached to the case with the calculation date and preparer.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Amounts that cannot be attributed logged with the reason for exclusion.
generic.Test population: All SIU cases with a substantiated or partially substantiated outcome in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if recoverable and avoided amounts are recorded as a single combined value.
generic.Exception handling path: Where the second reviewer disagrees, rework the calculation before it enters the register.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Case records recoverable and avoided amounts separately with a calculation basis.
generic.Evidence location: FRISS case savings record, ClaimCenter financials and the warehouse extract used.

steps.title: Pull paid-to-date and outstanding reserve from ClaimCenter
sop: Export the paid-to-date figure and the outstanding reserve for the claim.
Record the extract date so the figures are reproducible.
File the extract to the case.
Done when paid and reserve figures are extracted and filed.
verify: Extract shows the claim number and the extract date.
Pass when figures match the ClaimCenter financial screen.

steps.title: Quantify amounts already paid that are recoverable
sop: Identify payments attributable to the proven fraud or inflation.
Sum those payments as the recoverable amount.
Record which payments were included and why.
Done when the recoverable amount is quantified with its components.
verify: Component payments are listed with their transaction ids.
Pass when the sum equals the listed component total.

steps.title: Quantify amounts avoided by not paying
sop: Identify reserve released without payment due to the investigation.
Sum those amounts separately as the avoided amount.
Keep avoided amounts distinct from recovered amounts.
Done when the avoided amount is quantified separately.
verify: Avoided amount is stored in its own field.
Pass when avoided and recoverable are not combined.

steps.title: Deduct investigation and vendor costs where required
sop: Pull investigation hours and vendor spend for the case.
Apply the savings methodology rule on cost deduction.
Record whether costs were deducted and the resulting net figure.
Done when the cost treatment is applied and recorded.
verify: Cost figures reconcile to the recorded vendor spend.
Pass when the methodology rule applied is named.

steps.title: Re-perform the calculation as second reviewer
sop: Independently re-perform the recoverable and avoided calculations.
Compare the result to the preparer figures.
Record agreement or the difference identified.
Done when the second reviewer has re-performed and recorded the result.
verify: Reviewer identity is recorded and differs from the preparer.
Pass when any difference is resolved before registration.

steps.title: Record the figures and basis on the FRISS case
sop: Enter the recoverable and avoided amounts on the case savings fields.
Attach the calculation working and name the data sources used.
Record the reviewer sign-off reference.
Done when figures, working and sign-off are on the case.
verify: Case shows both amounts with the calculation attached.
Pass when the reviewer sign-off reference is present.

generic.Defined scope/population: The single claim action recommended from pay, partial pay, deny, rescind or refer to prosecution.
generic.In-scope period: From findings completion until the recommendation reaches the handling adjuster.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Disposition value, evidentiary basis, policy provision and manager approval recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: One recommendation exists per SIU case with no competing disposition entries.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Recommendation record retained with the recommending investigator and the recommendation date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Recommendations amended after manager review logged with the change and reason.
generic.Test population: All SIU cases reaching recommendation in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the disposition value is outside the controlled list or has no rationale.
generic.Exception handling path: Where the denial deadline cannot be met, recommend an alternative action and record why.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Case disposition field holds a controlled-list recommendation with a rationale note.
generic.Evidence location: FRISS case disposition field and the recommendation note on the ClaimCenter claim.

steps.title: Select one action from the controlled disposition list
sop: Choose pay, partial pay, deny, rescind or refer to prosecution.
Select one action only on the case disposition field.
Remove any competing draft disposition entries.
Done when a single controlled-list action is selected.
verify: Disposition value appears on the controlled list.
Pass when only one disposition entry exists on the case.

steps.title: State the evidentiary basis and policy provision
sop: Write the evidentiary basis supporting the chosen action.
Cite the policy provision engaged by that evidence.
Reference the exhibits relied on for each point.
Done when the basis and provision are recorded with exhibit references.
verify: Rationale cites a policy provision and exhibits.
Pass when no rationale is left as a general statement.

steps.title: Check the denial letter deadline can still be met
sop: Identify the claim-handling deadline for issuing a denial letter.
Compare it against the expected decision date.
Record whether the deadline is achievable.
Done when the denial deadline check is recorded.
verify: Check names the deadline date and its source.
Pass when an unachievable deadline triggers an alternative recommendation.

steps.title: Record that the claim decision remains with claims
sop: State on the recommendation that SIU recommends and claims decides.
Avoid wording that directs the adjuster to a decision.
Save the wording on the case recommendation note.
Done when the recommendation records the decision ownership.
verify: Note states the claim decision sits with claims.
Pass when no wording directs the adjuster to decide a particular way.

steps.title: Route the recommendation for SIU manager approval
sop: Review the disposition against the evidence and legal position.
Approve, amend or reject with a written reason.
Record the decision on the FRISS case before it reaches the adjuster.
Done when the manager approval decision is recorded.
verify: Approval decision is recorded with a reason.
Pass when no recommendation reaches the adjuster unapproved.

steps.title: Publish the approved recommendation to ClaimCenter
sop: Write the approved recommendation to the claim record.
Notify the handling adjuster through the claim system.
Confirm the recommendation text on the claim matches the case.
Done when the approved recommendation is visible on the claim.
verify: Claim recommendation text matches the FRISS case entry.

Log diary checks that returned no update.
