steps.title: Feed recovery-relevant outcomes to the recovery tracking record
sop: Pass restitution orders to the recovery tracking record on the claim.
Confirm the recovery amount and limitation dates are updated.
Record the handoff on the FRISS case.
Done when recovery-relevant outcomes reach the tracking record.
verify: Recovery record shows the restitution amount recorded.
Pass when the handoff is noted on the case.

generic.Defined scope/population: Criminal case developments affecting this claim that must be reflected in the claim file.
generic.In-scope period: From the first development notified until the criminal matter concludes.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Development date, source, claim status impact and attached court document recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Claim notes recorded equal developments reported by SIU for the claim.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Court documents attached to the claim file with their issue dates.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Developments reported without documentation logged with the source relied on.
generic.Test population: All claims with linked criminal proceedings in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a reported development has no dated claim note.
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate to the claims supervisor where a development changes reserve or settlement.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Claim notes contain a dated entry for each recorded criminal case development.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter claim notes and the court documents in the claim document repository.

steps.title: Receive the development notification from SIU
sop: Pass each criminal case development to the handling examiner.
State the development, its date and the source relied on.
Attach any court document received.
Done when the development has been notified with source and date.
verify: Notification names the development, date and source.
Pass when supporting documents are attached where available.

steps.title: Add a dated claim note for the development
sop: Create a claim note recording the development.
Record the development date and the source of the information.
Keep the note factual with no characterisation of the parties.
Done when a dated claim note exists for the development.
verify: Note carries the development date and source.
Pass when every notified development has a matching note.

steps.title: Attach court documents to the claim document repository
sop: File the charging document, plea or restitution order to the claim folder.
Set the document type so audit can retrieve it.
Reference the document id in the claim note.
Done when court documents are filed and referenced.
verify: Filed documents are typed and dated in the repository.
Pass when the claim note references each filed document.

steps.title: Update claim status or hold where the position changes
sop: Assess whether the development changes the handling position.
Update the claim status or the hold setting accordingly.
Record the change with the development as its basis.
Done when the claim status reflects the development.
verify: Status change references the development that caused it.
Pass when no material development leaves the status unreviewed.

steps.title: Notify adjuster and supervisor on reserve or settlement impact
sop: Assess whether the development affects reserve or settlement.
Notify the handling adjuster and the supervisor where it does.
Record the notification on the claim.
Done when impacted parties have been notified and the notice logged.
verify: Notification record names the recipients and the impact.
Pass when every reserve-affecting development is notified.

steps.title: Reconcile the claim notes against the SIU proceedings log
sop: Compare claim notes against the SIU criminal proceedings log.
Add notes for any development missing from the claim.
Record the reconciliation date on the claim.
Done when claim notes reconcile to the SIU proceedings log.
verify: Note count matches the SIU log entry count for the claim.
Pass when no logged development is absent from the claim.

generic.Defined scope/population: The archived SIU case record and its document set requiring a retention class and destruction date.
generic.In-scope period: From case closure date through the longest applicable retention period across involved states.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Retention class, destruction-eligible date, legal hold flag and access restriction recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Documents carrying retention metadata equals documents in the archived case set.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Retention metadata retained on the case record and on the archived document set.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Documents without a retention class logged and remediated before archive sign-off.
generic.Test population: All SIU cases archived in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a destruction date is set on a case carrying an active legal hold.
generic.Exception handling path: Apply a legal hold and suspend destruction where proceedings remain open.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Archived case carries a retention class and a destruction-eligible date.
generic.Evidence location: Claim document repository retention metadata and the Archer GRC retention register.

steps.title: Assign the SIU retention class using the longest state period
sop: Identify each involved state and its SIU file retention period.
Select the longest applicable period as the retention class.
Record the class and the states considered in Archer GRC.
Done when the retention class is assigned and recorded.
verify: Class chosen equals the longest applicable state period.
Pass when the states considered are recorded.

steps.title: Set the destruction-eligible date from case closure
sop: Take the case closure date as the retention start.
Calculate the destruction-eligible date from that date.
Confirm the loss date was not used as the start.
Done when the destruction-eligible date is calculated and recorded.
verify: Retention start equals the case closure date.
Pass when the destruction date equals closure plus the retention period.

steps.title: Apply a legal hold where proceedings remain open
sop: Check whether criminal or civil proceedings remain open on the case.
Apply the legal hold flag where they do.
Confirm the hold suspends the destruction schedule.
Done when the legal hold state is set correctly for the case.
verify: Legal hold flag matches the open-proceedings position.
Pass when no destruction date is active under a legal hold.

steps.title: Restrict archive access to SIU, compliance and legal roles
sop: Set access on the archived case to SIU, compliance and legal roles.
Remove general claims access from the archived set.
Record the access configuration applied.
Done when archive access is restricted to the named roles.
verify: Access list contains only SIU, compliance and legal roles.
Pass when the configuration is recorded on the archive.

steps.title: Verify retention metadata on case and document set
sop: Check the retention class and date appear on the case record.
Check the same metadata appears on the archived document set.
Remediate any document lacking retention metadata.
Done when retention metadata is present in both places.
verify: Documents carrying metadata equal documents in the archive set.
Pass when no archived document lacks a retention class.

steps.title: Sign off the retention controls with the SIU manager
sop: Review retention class, destruction date, hold state and access.
Record the sign-off on the Archer GRC retention register.
Return any item that fails the review for remediation.
Done when the retention controls are signed off.
verify: Sign-off names the case and the retention class approved.
Pass when no failed item is left unremediated.

generic.Defined scope/population: The complete SIU case set including report, exhibits, evidence index, custody log, vendor reports and correspondence.
generic.In-scope period: All case material from assignment through closure at the archive date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Archive package reference, evidence item count and physical evidence disposition recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Documents in the archived package equal items on the evidence index.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Archived package retained read-only with the transfer date and archiving user.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Missing items found at archive check logged with the recovery action taken.
generic.Test population: All SIU cases archived in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any archived case package remains writable after transfer.
generic.Exception handling path: Hold the archive until every missing index item is located or its absence explained.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Archived package is retrievable by case number and matches the evidence index count.
generic.Evidence location: Claim document repository archive and the FRISS case archive reference.

steps.title: Assemble the complete case set for archive
sop: Gather report, exhibits, evidence index, custody log, vendor reports and correspondence.
Order the package so items are retrievable by index reference.
Record the assembled item count.
Done when the complete case set is assembled with a counted index.
verify: Assembled count is recorded against the case.
Pass when all six material categories are present.

steps.title: Run the archive completeness check against the evidence index
sop: Compare each evidence index entry against the assembled package.
List any item present on the index but missing from the package.
Locate the missing item or record why it cannot be included.
Done when the completeness check shows no unresolved missing item.
verify: Package item count equals the evidence index count.
Pass when every missing item has a recorded resolution.

steps.title: Move the case package to the archive repository
sop: Transfer the package to the archive repository location.
Record the transfer date and the transferring user.
Confirm the case number is searchable in the archive.
Done when the package is transferred and searchable by case number.
verify: Search by case number retrieves the archived package.
Pass when the transfer date and user are recorded.

steps.title: Record physical evidence disposition with authorisation
sop: Record whether each physical item was returned, retained or destroyed.
Attach the authorisation for each disposition.
Cross-check the custody log agrees with the recorded disposition.
Done when every physical item has an authorised recorded disposition.
verify: Disposition entries match the custody log final entries.
Pass when each disposition names its authoriser.

steps.title: Confirm the archived package is read-only
sop: Test that the archived package cannot be edited after transfer.
Correct permissions where the package remains writable.
Record the read-only confirmation on the archive record.
Done when the archived package is confirmed read-only.
verify: Edit attempt on the archived package is rejected.
Pass when the read-only confirmation is recorded.

steps.title: Record the archive reference on the FRISS case
sop: Enter the archive package reference on the FRISS case.
Confirm the case can be traced to the archive from the case record.
Note the archive date on the case header.
Done when the archive reference and date are on the case.
verify: Case header shows the archive reference and date.
Pass when the reference retrieves the archived package.

generic.Defined scope/population: Red flags, techniques and detection timing observed during this investigation and worth reusing.
generic.In-scope period: The full investigation lifecycle from referral to disposition.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Proven indicators, noise indicators, new modus operandi, detection gap and technique notes recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Indicators assessed equals indicators ticked at referral for this case.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Lessons entry retained in the knowledge base with the entry date and author.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Lessons that cannot be generalised logged with the reason they stay case specific.
generic.Test population: All closed SIU cases in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the lessons entry is untagged by scheme type or line of business.
generic.Exception handling path: Where no lesson arises, record a nil-return entry rather than leaving the case blank.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Lessons-learned entry exists tagged by scheme type and line of business.
generic.Evidence location: FRISS knowledge base entry and the supporting case data in the enterprise data warehouse.

steps.title: Record which red flags proved out and which were noise
sop: List indicators ticked at referral and mark each proved or noise.
Record the evidence that settled each classification.
Save the assessment to the lessons entry.
Done when each referral indicator is classified proved or noise.
verify: Classification covers every indicator ticked at referral.
Pass when each classification names its evidence.

steps.title: Describe any new modus operandi observed
sop: Describe any new scheme pattern seen on this case.
Write it in terms another investigator could screen for.
Avoid case-specific detail that prevents reuse.
Done when new modus operandi are described in screenable terms.
verify: Description states observable signals rather than case narrative.
Pass when a nil return is recorded where no new pattern arose.

steps.title: Identify where detection was late and the upstream control gap
sop: Compare the loss date, first payment date and referral date.
Identify where earlier detection was possible.
Name the upstream control that would have caught it sooner.
Done when the detection timing gap and control are recorded.
verify: Timing analysis cites the dates used.
Pass when the named control is specific rather than generic.

steps.title: Record techniques that failed or wasted spend
sop: List investigative steps that produced no evidential value.
Record the cost attached to each where vendor spend was involved.
State what should be done instead next time.
Done when failed techniques and their costs are recorded.
verify: Each failed technique records its cost or a nil cost.
Pass when an alternative approach is stated for each.

steps.title: Corroborate the lesson against warehouse case history
sop: Query the warehouse for similar cases and their indicator outcomes.
Test whether the lesson holds across more than this single case.
Record the corroboration result and its population size.
Done when the lesson is tested against comparable case history.
verify: Corroboration records the population size tested.
Pass when single-case lessons are marked as unconfirmed.

steps.title: Submit the tagged lessons entry to the SIU knowledge base
sop: Review the lessons entry for accuracy and reusability.
Tag the entry by scheme type and line of business.
Publish it to the SIU knowledge base.
Done when the tagged entry is published to the knowledge base.
verify: Entry carries both scheme type and line of business tags.
Pass when the entry is retrievable by those tags.

generic.Defined scope/population: Systemic fraud patterns confirmed from closed-case analysis that warrant a control change.
generic.In-scope period: The analysis period covered by the closed-case data supporting the pattern.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Supporting case numbers, quantified exposure, affected product or channel and control change requested.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Cases cited in the escalation equal cases in the confirmed pattern set.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Escalation record retained with the raising manager and the escalation date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Escalations closed without a decision logged with the reason and the owner agreement.
generic.Test population: All patterns escalated to fraud strategy in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if an escalation lacks a named owner or a target response date.
generic.Exception handling path: Re-escalate where no acknowledgement arrives by the agreed date.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Escalation record exists with named owner, target date and acknowledgement.
generic.Evidence location: Archer GRC escalation record with supporting analysis in the enterprise data warehouse.

steps.title: Package the pattern with supporting case numbers
sop: Assemble the confirmed pattern description and its supporting case numbers.
State the analysis period and the data source used.
Save the package on the FRISS pattern record.
Done when the pattern package with case numbers is assembled.
verify: Case numbers listed match the confirmed pattern set.
Pass when the analysis period and source are stated.

steps.title: Quantify exposure and identify the affected product or channel
sop: Query the warehouse for paid and reserved exposure across the pattern cases.
Identify the product, channel or producer most affected.
Record the exposure figure and the affected segment.
Done when exposure and affected segment are quantified.
verify: Exposure figure reconciles to the claim financials queried.
Pass when the affected product or channel is named.

steps.title: State the specific control change requested
sop: Name the requested change - new rule, model feature, underwriting referral or provider review.
Explain how the change would have caught the pattern earlier.
Record the request on the escalation package.
Done when a specific control change is stated with its rationale.
verify: Request names one of the controlled change types.
Pass when the rationale links the change to the pattern.

steps.title: Raise the escalation through the standing route in the GRC platform
sop: Create the escalation record in Archer GRC on the standing route.
Attach the pattern package and the exposure analysis.
Record the escalation date and the raising manager.
Done when the escalation is raised with its supporting package.
verify: Escalation record holds the pattern package attachment.
Pass when escalation date and raiser are recorded.

steps.title: Obtain written acknowledgement with owner and target date
sop: Request written acknowledgement from fraud strategy and prevention.
Capture the named owner and the target response date.
Re-escalate where no acknowledgement arrives in the agreed window.
Done when acknowledgement with owner and target date is recorded.
verify: Acknowledgement names an owner and a target date.
Pass when unacknowledged escalations show a re-escalation.

steps.title: Track the escalation to a decision
sop: Diary the target response date on the escalation record.
Record the decision reached on the requested control change.
Keep the escalation open until a decision is recorded.
Done when the escalation carries a recorded decision.
verify: Escalation shows a decision rather than only an acknowledgement.
Pass when no escalation is closed at acknowledgement stage.

generic.Defined scope/population: The final disposition code and closure statistics for this SIU case.
generic.In-scope period: From approved recommendation to final disposition setting.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Disposition code, closure date, total investigation hours and total vendor spend populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Vendor spend recorded equals vendor invoices raised against the case.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Disposition record retained with the deciding manager and the disposition date.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Dispositions diverging from the approved recommendation logged with the reason.
generic.Test population: All SIU cases reaching final disposition in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the disposition code is outside the controlled list or the closure date is blank.
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate for review where the disposition and recommendation cannot be reconciled.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Case holds a final disposition code from the controlled list with a closure date.
generic.Evidence location: FRISS case disposition record and the disposition write-back on the ClaimCenter claim.

steps.title: Set the final disposition code on the FRISS case
sop: Select substantiated, unsubstantiated, inconclusive or withdrawn.
Set the code on the case disposition field.
Record the deciding manager and the disposition date.
Done when the final disposition code is set with a date.
verify: Disposition value appears on the controlled list.
Pass when deciding manager and date are recorded.

steps.title: Reconcile the disposition against the approved recommendation
sop: Compare the final disposition against the approved recommendation.
Where they diverge, record the reason for the divergence.
Escalate unexplained divergences for manager review.
Done when disposition and recommendation are reconciled.
verify: Reconciliation names both values compared.
Pass when every divergence carries a recorded reason.

steps.title: Populate the closure date on the case header
sop: Enter the closure date on the case header.
Confirm it is not earlier than the last investigative activity.
Save so the retention clock can start from it.
Done when a valid closure date is on the case header.
verify: Closure date is on or after the last activity date.
Pass when the closure date field is non-blank.

steps.title: Record total investigation hours
sop: Sum recorded investigator hours across the case.
Enter the total on the case closure statistics.
Note the source of the hours figures.
Done when total investigation hours are recorded.
verify: Hours total reconciles to recorded time entries.
Pass when the source of the figures is stated.

steps.title: Record total vendor spend against the case
sop: Sum vendor invoices raised against the case in ClaimCenter.
Enter the total on the case closure statistics.
Investigate any invoice not matched to an engagement.
Done when total vendor spend is recorded and reconciled.
verify: Spend total equals the sum of case vendor invoices.
Pass when every invoice matches a recorded engagement.

steps.title: Write the disposition back to the originating claim
sop: Confirm the disposition writes back to the ClaimCenter claim record.
Check the claim shows the same code as the SIU case.
Correct the write-back where values differ.
Done when the claim shows the final disposition code.
verify: Claim disposition code equals the FRISS case code.
Pass when no claim is left without the disposition.

generic.Defined scope/population: The final SIU report, recommendation and hold position handed back to the claims handler.
generic.In-scope period: From final disposition until the adjuster acknowledgement is recorded.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Recommendation, supporting evidence mapping, remaining deadlines and hold state recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Recommended actions handed over equals recommendations approved on the case.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Handover note retained on the claim with its date and the handing-over investigator.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Handovers without adjuster acknowledgement logged and chased to closure.
generic.Test population: All SIU cases handed back to claims in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if the handover note carries no adjuster acknowledgement.
generic.Exception handling path: Escalate to the claims supervisor where the adjuster does not acknowledge within the window.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Claim holds a dated SIU handover note with recommendation and adjuster acknowledgement.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter handover note cross-referenced on the FRISS case record.

steps.title: Send the final report and recommendation through the claim system
sop: Post the final report and recommendation to the claim in ClaimCenter.
Address it to the handling adjuster and the claims supervisor.
Avoid handing over by email alone so the trail is auditable.
Done when report and recommendation are posted to the claim.
verify: Claim note shows the report and recommendation attached.
Pass when the note names adjuster and supervisor as recipients.

steps.title: Map evidence to each recommended action
sop: State which evidence supports each recommended action.
Reference the exhibit numbers so the adjuster can defend the decision.
Record the mapping in the handover note.
Done when each recommended action is mapped to its evidence.
verify: Each action names the exhibits that support it.
Pass when no action is handed over unsupported.

steps.title: Advise the remaining claim-handling deadlines
sop: List the claim-handling deadlines still running on the claim.
State the latest date each decision can be made.
Record the deadlines in the handover note.
Done when remaining deadlines are recorded in the handover.
verify: Deadline list names each obligation and its date.
Pass when the handover shows time remaining for the decision.

steps.title: Release or maintain the SIU hold in the same note
sop: State whether the SIU hold is released or maintained.
Where maintained, record the reason and the new review date.
Apply the hold change in ClaimCenter at the same time.
Done when the hold state is stated and applied.
verify: Hold state in ClaimCenter matches the handover note.
Pass when a maintained hold carries a review date.

steps.title: Obtain adjuster acknowledgement of the handover
sop: Read the handover note and the recommendation.
Acknowledge receipt on the claim and record the intended decision.
Raise questions to SIU before the decision is made.
Done when the adjuster has acknowledged and recorded an intended decision.
verify: Acknowledgement is recorded on the claim with a date.
Pass when the intended claim decision is recorded.

steps.title: Cross-reference the handover on the FRISS case
sop: Record the handover date and acknowledgement on the FRISS case.
Link the claim note reference to the case record.
Chase where acknowledgement has not been received.
Done when the handover is cross-referenced and acknowledged or chased.
verify: Case record references the claim handover note.
Pass when unacknowledged handovers show a logged chase.

generic.Defined scope/population: Closed SIU cases analysed by scheme type, provider, repairer, geography, channel and producer.
generic.In-scope period: The closed-case analysis window agreed for the pattern review period.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Pattern description, supporting case numbers, volume test result and exposure recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Cases in each confirmed pattern equal cases returned by the supporting query.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Pattern analysis output retained with the query run date and analyst name.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Candidate patterns rejected on volume logged with the counts that failed the test.
generic.Test population: All SIU cases closed within the analysis window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if a confirmed pattern lists no supporting case numbers.
generic.Exception handling path: Where volume is too small, mark the pattern as watch-only rather than confirmed.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Pattern analysis output lists each confirmed pattern with case numbers and exposure.
generic.Evidence location: Enterprise data warehouse query outputs surfaced on the BI reporting platform.

steps.title: Query closed SIU cases by scheme and party dimensions
sop: Query the warehouse for closed cases by scheme type, provider and repairer.
Add geography, channel and producer dimensions to the query.
Record the query definition and run date.
Done when the closed-case dataset is produced across all dimensions.
verify: Query definition and run date are recorded with the output.
Pass when all six dimensions are present in the dataset.

steps.title: Identify clusters of repeat parties and locations
sop: Look for repeat providers across substantiated cases.
Look for repeat addresses and repeat producers.
List each candidate cluster with its case numbers.
Done when candidate clusters are listed with case numbers.
verify: Each cluster lists the cases that form it.
Pass when clusters are drawn from substantiated cases where relevant.

steps.title: Test each candidate pattern for volume significance
sop: Compare cluster volume against the base rate for that dimension.
Reject clusters that are small-number noise.
Record the counts behind each accept or reject decision.
Done when every candidate has a recorded volume test result.
verify: Each decision records the counts it relied on.
Pass when rejected candidates are logged rather than dropped silently.

steps.title: Quantify the exposure attached to each confirmed pattern
sop: Sum paid and reserved amounts across the cases in each pattern.
Record the exposure figure with its calculation basis.
Reconcile the figure to the source claim financials.
Done when each confirmed pattern carries a quantified exposure.
verify: Exposure reconciles to the claim financial source data.
Pass when every confirmed pattern shows an exposure figure.

steps.title: Corroborate patterns against FRISS case detail
sop: Read the FRISS case narratives behind each confirmed pattern.
Confirm the cases genuinely share the alleged modus operandi.
Record the corroboration outcome per pattern.
Done when each pattern is corroborated against case detail.
verify: Corroboration names the cases read for each pattern.
Pass when patterns not corroborated are downgraded to watch-only.

steps.title: Publish the pattern output and review with the SIU manager
sop: Publish the pattern analysis on the BI reporting platform.
Review each confirmed pattern for escalation readiness.
Record which patterns proceed to escalation.
Done when the pattern output is published and reviewed.
verify: Published output lists patterns with case numbers and exposure.
Pass when escalation decisions are recorded per pattern.

generic.Defined scope/population: The claim-hold state on this claim following the SIU disposition, released or continued.
generic.In-scope period: From disposition until the hold is released or the next recorded review date.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Hold state, effective date, review date where continued and notification record populated.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Hold state in ClaimCenter matches the hold state recorded on the FRISS case.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Notification note retained on the claim with the effective date of the hold change.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Holds continued past the review date logged with a new review date and reason.

generic.Exception handling path: Escalate to the claims supervisor where hold duration risks the handling deadline.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Claim shows the current hold state with an effective date and an adjuster notification.
generic.Evidence location: ClaimCenter hold panel and notification note, cross-noted on the FRISS case.

steps.title: Set the hold flag to released or continued in ClaimCenter
sop: Read the SIU disposition and decide release or continuation.
Set the claim hold flag accordingly with an effective date.
Record the basis for the decision on the claim.
Done when the hold flag reflects the disposition with an effective date.
verify: Hold state matches the recorded SIU disposition.
Pass when the effective date is recorded on the claim.

steps.title: Notify the handling adjuster through the claim system
sop: Post a notification note to the handling adjuster on the claim.
State the hold change and its effective date.
Avoid email-only notification so the trail is auditable.
Done when the adjuster notification is recorded on the claim.
verify: Notification note names the adjuster and the effective date.
Pass when the notification sits on the claim record.

steps.title: Record a new review date where the hold continues
sop: Where the hold continues, set a new review date.
Record why the hold must remain in place.
Create the review diary on the claim.
Done when continued holds carry a new review date and reason.
verify: Continued holds show a future review date.
Pass when the reason for continuation is recorded.

steps.title: Confirm the payment block is lifted on release
sop: Where the hold is released, test the claim payment screen.
Confirm no residual SIU block prevents payment.
Report any residual block back to SIU for correction.
Done when the payment block is confirmed lifted on released claims.
verify: Payment screen shows no SIU block on a released claim.
Pass when residual blocks are reported and corrected.

steps.title: Check total hold duration against the handling deadline
sop: Calculate the total elapsed hold duration on the claim.
Compare it against the state claim-handling deadline.
Flag any breach for supervisor escalation.
Done when hold duration has been compared to the deadline.
verify: Comparison names the deadline and the elapsed duration.
Pass when every breach is flagged for escalation.

steps.title: Cross-note the hold state on the FRISS case
sop: Record the hold state and effective date on the FRISS case.
Confirm case and claim agree on the hold position.
Correct either side where they diverge.
Done when case and claim show the same hold state.
verify: FRISS hold state equals the ClaimCenter hold state.
Pass when no divergence remains unresolved.

generic.Defined scope/population: SIU performance and fraud-trend metrics for the reporting period across all closed and open cases.

generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Savings total in the report reconciles to the claims financial records.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Published scorecard version archived with its publication date and distribution list.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Metrics that could not be produced logged with the data gap and the remediation.

generic.Exception handling path: Hold publication and correct the source data where reconciliation fails.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Published SIU scorecard exists for the period with savings reconciled to claims financials.

steps.title: Pull the core SIU performance metrics from the warehouse
sop: Extract referral volume, acceptance rate, cycle time and substantiation rate.
Extract the savings figures for the reporting period.
Record the extract run date and the period boundaries.
Done when the core metric extract is produced for the period.
verify: Extract states the period boundaries used.
Pass when all five core metrics are present.

steps.title: Report model precision against the prior period
sop: Calculate referrals accepted versus false positives from the FRISS outcome data.
Compare the result to the prior period figure.
Record the movement and any driver identified.
Done when model precision and its movement are calculated.
verify: Comparison shows current and prior period values.
Pass when the movement driver is stated where material.

steps.title: Reconcile the savings total to claims financial records

steps.title: Write the fraud-trend commentary

steps.title: Assemble the scorecard on the BI reporting platform
sop: Build the scorecard view with the metrics and commentary.

Version the scorecard before publication.

verify: Scorecard figures match the reconciled extract values.

steps.title: Issue to leadership distribution and archive the version
sop: Issue the scorecard to the claims and compliance leadership distribution.
Archive the published version with its publication date.
Record the distribution list on the archive record.

generic.Defined scope/population: Avoided indemnity and recovered cash attributable to this case for the savings register.

generic.Required fields populated and valid: Avoided amount, recovered amount, calculation working and reviewer sign-off recorded.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Case savings total reconciles to the claim financial transactions.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Calculation working attached with the preparation date and preparer name.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Amounts excluded from savings logged with the reason for exclusion.
generic.Test population: All SIU cases recording savings in the review window.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if savings are recorded against a case with an unsubstantiated disposition.
generic.Exception handling path: Where cash has not been received, hold the recovered amount at zero until receipt.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Case savings record holds avoided and recovered amounts with a reviewer sign-off.
generic.Evidence location: FRISS case savings record with source figures in ClaimCenter and the data warehouse.

steps.title: Enter avoided indemnity against the case savings field

Enter that figure in the avoided indemnity field.
Record the reserve transactions relied on.
Done when the avoided indemnity figure is entered with its transactions.
verify: Figure ties to named reserve release transactions.
Pass when the avoided field is populated separately.

steps.title: Enter recovered amounts only once cash is received
sop: Check the claim financials for cash actually received.
Enter only received amounts in the recovered field.
Leave expected recoveries out until receipt is confirmed.
Done when recovered amounts reflect cash actually received.
verify: Recovered figure ties to received cash transactions.

steps.title: Attach the calculation working for audit re-performance
sop: Prepare working showing each component of both figures.
Name the data sources and extract dates used.
Attach the working to the FRISS case savings record.
Done when the calculation working is attached to the case.
verify: Working shows components summing to the recorded figures.
Pass when the data sources and dates are named.

steps.title: Obtain second-reviewer sign-off before register entry
sop: Have a reviewer other than the preparer re-perform the figures.
Record the sign-off with the reviewer name and date.
Return the figures for rework where the reviewer disagrees.
Done when a second-reviewer sign-off is recorded.
verify: Reviewer differs from the preparer of the figures.
Pass when no figure enters the register unsigned.

steps.title: Reconcile the case savings total to claim financials
sop: Compare the case savings total to the claim financial transactions.
Investigate and record any difference.
Correct the figures where the difference is an error.
Done when the savings total reconciles to claim financials.
verify: Reconciliation shows both totals and any residual difference.
Pass when no unexplained difference remains.

steps.title: Check the disposition supports recording savings
sop: Read the case disposition code before the register entry.
Reject savings recorded against an unsubstantiated disposition.
Record the disposition check outcome on the case.
Done when the disposition check has been recorded.
verify: Check names the disposition code reviewed.
Pass when no savings sit against an unsubstantiated case.

generic.Defined scope/population: Closed-case records with indicators, disposition, model score and outcome fields for the analytics load.
generic.In-scope period: Cases closed within the extract period agreed with fraud analytics.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Every mandatory schema field populated with no null disposition or model score.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Rows loaded to the analytics table equal rows in the submitted extract.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Extract file retained with the extract date, schema version and row count.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Records rejected at validation logged with the failing field and the fix applied.
generic.Test population: All cases closed in the extract period.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail if any record loads with a null disposition or a null model score.
generic.Exception handling path: Reject and correct failing records rather than loading them with placeholder values.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Loaded batch row count in the analytics table matches the submitted extract count.
generic.Evidence location: Enterprise data warehouse analytics table and the FRISS extract record.

steps.title: Extract the closed-case record set from FRISS
sop: Extract closed cases for the period with indicators, disposition and model score.
Include the outcome fields required by the analytics schema.
Record the extract date and the row count produced.
Done when the closed-case extract is produced with a row count.
verify: Extract row count is recorded with the extract date.
Pass when all schema-required fields are present.

steps.title: Validate the extract against the agreed schema
sop: Run schema validation across the extract.
Reject any record with a missing mandatory field.
Log each rejection with the failing field.
Done when validation is complete and rejections are logged.
verify: Validation log lists each rejected record and its failing field.
Pass when no record with a missing mandatory field is retained.

steps.title: Confirm personal data is pseudonymised where identity is not needed
sop: Review which fields carry identifying personal data.
Pseudonymise fields the analytics use case does not require.
Record the pseudonymisation applied.
Done when unnecessary identifying data is pseudonymised.
verify: Record states which fields were pseudonymised.

steps.title: Load the extract to the fraud analytics table
sop: Load the validated extract to the analytics table in the warehouse.
Capture the load timestamp and the batch reference.
Halt and investigate on any load error.
Done when the batch is loaded with a captured reference.
verify: Load reference and timestamp are recorded.
Pass when the load completed without unresolved errors.

steps.title: Reconcile loaded rows to the submitted extract count
sop: Count rows in the analytics table for the batch reference.
Compare against the submitted extract row count.
Investigate and resolve any difference.
Done when loaded and submitted counts reconcile.
verify: Both counts are documented against the batch reference.

steps.title: Obtain analytics confirmation that the batch was accepted
sop: Request confirmation from analytics that the batch is usable for model tuning.
Record the confirmation and its date on the FRISS extract record.
Re-submit where the batch is rejected.
Done when the acceptance confirmation is recorded.
verify: Confirmation names the batch reference accepted.

steps.title: Set the SIU disposition code on the claim header

Set the SIU disposition code on the ClaimCenter claim header.
Record the update date and updating user.

steps.title: Set the outcome classification alongside the disposition
sop: Set the outcome classification field on the claim.

Correct any inconsistent combination before saving.

steps.title: Confirm the claim code matches the closed SIU case
sop: Compare the claim disposition code against the FRISS closed case code.
Raise a correction where they differ.
Record the confirmation on the case.

steps.title: Record the resulting claim action taken
sop: Record whether the claim was paid, partially paid, denied or rescinded.

Reference the SIU recommendation that informed the action.

steps.title: Clear disproved fraud indicator flags in ClaimCenter
sop: Review the red-flag panel against the investigation findings.
Clear indicators that were disproved so future screening is not distorted.
Record the reason each indicator was cleared.

Pass when proven indicators remain set on the claim.

sop: Test the claim payment screen for a residual SIU block.

Record the confirmation that the claim can progress.
